chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Interview
paragraphs: In Sucheng, a red business car was speeding along the main road.
It left a trail of cars behind.

Xia Xi was in the driver's seat. She had a high nose bridge and as she raised her head, it revealed a fair and delicate neck. She held the steering wheel tightly with both hands as if she was secretly competing with an invisible enemy.
Fang Heng was shivering in the passenger seat.
He could vaguely feel the killing intent coming from Xia Xi.
She was so wild even when driving!
Fang Heng realized that this body still had some memory loss.
He could no longer remember how he and Xia Xi met, but he clearly remembered that he had always been annoyed with Xia Xi and his attitude towards her was not very good.
It was strange, Xia Xi was quite pretty.
"Have you remembered all the information I sent you last night? You'll likely be asked about the development of the enterprise, and big companies will be very concerned about this aspect."
"Fang Heng! I'm talking to you, do you hear me?"
Xia Xi frowned, turned her head to look at Fang Heng and raised her voice by two levels.
"Fang Heng? Why are you always like this? You have to pay more attention to your matters, okay?"
"Do you not want to get out of this for the rest of your life?"
Madam!! Look at the road! Look at the car, okay!
Fang Heng's face turned even paler.
He was panicking to death, but Fang Heng still maintained his cold and aloof persona on the surface. He said in a deep voice, "I'm listening."
"With your capabilities, passing the interview shouldn't be a problem."
Xia Xi turned her head and carefully observed Fang Heng from the corner of her eyes. "Also, if they ask about the past, control your emotions."
"Okay."
The car stopped in front of a high-tech building. Fang Heng alighted from the car.
His legs were still a little weak.
Racing gangs were too scary. Fang Heng almost thought that he would lose his life on the way.

Xia Xi was a bit uneasy. She was worried that Fang Heng would lose control of his temper, so she drove the car and followed him for a distance. She pressed the horn twice and poked her head out of the window.
"Do you want me to go with you?"
"No need!"
Fang Heng tried his best to imitate the tone of the original owner of the body.
"Okay, then all the best."
After watching Xia Xi drive away, Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief and raised his head.
In the towering technology building, the exquisite logo of the company was hung on the external wall of the building.
A phoenix soared into the sky. Every feather was meticulously crafted and looked lifelike under the sunlight.
It must have cost a fortune.
"Phoenix Sound Gaming Company..."
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
The original owner of the body had investigated Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
In the game, players' talent skills were not fixed.
When a character reached level 10, he could receive his first talent enhancement.
Players needed to find their talent enhancement plan in the game to level up.
Talent enhancement plan levels varied from E-S.
S-level talent enhancement plan was also extremely rare!
According to the data released annually by the federal government, the number of players who successfully obtained and completed the S-level talent enhancement plan each year was less than 10.
But the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company had the highest level, the S-level talent enhancement plan mission!
The owner of this body had wanted to obtain Phoenix Sound Gaming Company's S-level talent enhancement plan before!
Fang Heng scratched his head.
Then, scenes of his memories surfaced in his mind.
Ever since he was kicked out by the club, Fang Heng had also tried to look for a job.
Because of the highly publicized and sensational match-fixing incident, any gaming company and club that had done a little background work would be aware of Fang Heng's character.
The resumes that Fang Heng handed out were almost like stones dropped into the ocean, never to be seen or heard again. He was even ridiculed by some gaming companies when they replied to his resume.
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, office on the 17th floor.
Fang Heng sat on a stool.
Opposite him were two men and a woman.
The three of them were from the management of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, as well as the interviewers.
The man sitting in the middle looked to be about fifty to sixty years old. His back was straight and his clothes were neatly arranged without a single wrinkle. He was also in good spirits.
He was Pan Guanglin, the game technical director of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. He was in charge of the company's in-house game technology.
The woman sitting on his left was about forty years old. She gave off a shrewd and capable feeling.
The middle-aged man on the right was hugging his arms. He did not even lift his eyelids from beginning to end. It was as if he was asleep.
It was strange. Even though he was wearing a suit, he still gave off a sense of cynicism.
The female assistant secretary introduced him.

"Fang Heng, a former member of an A-class gaming guild club. He has been exposed to gaming competitions since high school. He has trained for more than ten years and has survived in the zombie apocalypse game for more than two years. He has an initial talent related to the zombie apocalypse game. His talent level is S..."
Pan Guanglin nodded repeatedly.
It was the first time they met and he had a pretty good impression of Fang Heng.

Yesterday, the zombie apocalypse in the King of Gods' game had opened District 8, and all the gaming companies had taken action upon hearing the news. Phoenix Sound Gaming Company was also in urgent need of talents in this field.
Not to mention that Fang Heng was personally introduced by President Qin.

Four years after graduation, Qin Shuran won the trust of her family and underwent training to gain experience for her family business. This time, she even acquired two gaming companies and merged them to establish Phoenix Sound Gaming Company to enter the gaming industry.
For a time, she created a huge commotion in Sucheng. It was as if she wanted to compete for the top position.
Pan Guanglin was still very impressed with Qin Shuran. He said, "Since you are recommended by President Qin, it shouldn't be a problem."
"Huh? Exempted from the interview?"
"Xia Xi was so highly revered?"
Fang Heng was surprised.
Xue Yuling said, "Fang Heng, I have another question I want to ask."
"Mr Fang Heng, I'm very curious why you chose to leave the club."
Fang Heng felt that the other party was not friendly. He glanced at Xue Yuling and replied, "Personal reasons."
"Can you explain it in detail?"
"Personal reasons. I don't want to talk about these things."
Pan Guanglin realized something.
"President Xue seems to be very concerned about this issue?"
Xue Yuling took out her phone and flipped through an article on it. She handed a piece of text to Pan Guanglin, who was sitting in the middle.
"Director Pan, take a look at this first."
On the phone was a report about Fang Heng.
Match-fixing? Internal discord?
All kinds of negative information about Fang Heng made Pan Guanglin's face darken.
He was upright, and could not accept corruption or violence in a person's character.
In Pan Guanglin's view, Fang Heng was eliminated due to his involvement in match-fixing.
The company could not accept such a person!
Pan Guanglin put down the phone.
"Mr Fang Heng, please explain. If you can't give a reasonable explanation, our company will not welcome you."
Xue Yuling looked at Fang Heng with a smug expression. She was here to reveal Fang Heng's true colours.

The company had taken a keen interest in the newly established business department. In addition to the sudden opening of District 8 in the game, the newly established gaming department had become a hot topic in the company.
Countless pairs of eyes in the company were looking at this place.
Including Xue Yuling, her nephew had also participated in this interview.
Unfortunately, Fang Heng was in her way.
Fang Heng stared at Xue Yuling without saying a word. He felt inexplicably unhappy in his heart.
"What did I do to offend her?"
There was no such person in his memory.

Pan Guanglin's face was expressionless. When he saw that Fang Heng didn't answer, he said in a low voice, "I'm sorry, Fang Heng. I made you come here for nothing. I'll explain this matter to President Qin personally."
As he was speaking, the office door was suddenly pushed open.
"President Qin."
Pan Guanglin and the others stood up at the same time.
President Qin?
Fang Heng also turned around when he heard that. He looked at the woman who walked in through the door and subconsciously stood up as well.
He saw a familiar face.
Qin Shuran?
She was Xia Xi's friend?
"President Qin, I happen to have something to report to you..."
A surprised voice interrupted Pan Guanglin's words.
"Fang Heng? Why is it you?"
Huh?
Fang Heng turned his head and looked at the person beside Qin Shuran.
"Jimmy?"
Fang Heng never thought that he would meet a player who had gone through thick and thin in the game here.
"Hahahahaha."
The skinny old man, Jimmy, laughed loudly. He looked very happy and walked up to pat Fang Heng on the shoulder, then turned back to look at Qin Shuran.

"So everything is part of President Qin's plan. This is the big surprise you mentioned just now, right? No wonder my friend is so impressed with Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. Hahaha, I'm very satisfied with your efficiency."
Everyone was baffled when they heard Jimmy's words.
They only knew that Jimmy was here to discuss a partnership on behalf of a foreign joint venture company. Phoenix Sound Gaming Company valued this partnership very much.
This kid knew Jimmy?
And it sounded like they were very familiar with each other.
Xue Yuling felt like the matter was already out of her control.
Pan Guanglin was smart enough to shut his mouth.

Qin Shuran's beautiful eyes quickly swept over Fang Heng. She gave the secretary a look and said, "Mr Jimmy, as long as you're satisfied. You don't have much time in the real world. Let's talk about cooperation first."
"Okay, okay. Let's talk about cooperation first."
Jimmy was very happy. He nodded repeatedly.
Last night, Jimmy had personally witnessed Fang Heng's powerful abilities in the game.
Among other things, just the food alone was enough to make him drool.
Jimmy wore a smile on his face.
Well, at least he won't go hungry in the game anymore!

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Nails and Wooden Planks
paragraphs: Fang Heng thought back to the interview and felt that the old woman was targeting him.
One step at a time.
The development of the game was going well. After a while, the trading channel between players would open. As long as they could sell some materials, it would not be difficult to fill their stomachs.
He was forced by Xia Xi to come for the interview.
Fang Heng did not want to stay here for too long.
He took a sip of coffee.
As expected of a big company, the taste of coffee was pure bliss.
The human resource lady carried a stack of documents and hurried into the reception room.

"Mr Fang Heng, this is an emergency. Our company will sign an internship contract with you directly. The probation period will be half a month and the monthly salary will be 30,000 yuan. It will start from today. You will be confirmed automatically after half a month.
"This is the contract. Can you see if there are any problems?"
Do I get to sign the contract so soon?
30,000 yuan per month?
In Sucheng, 30,000 yuan was considered a high salary.
However, Fang Heng hesitated for a moment.
Was it really necessary to join Phoenix Sound Company?
Yes, at least for now, he was short of money.

The game had just been launched and he lacked trading channels. It was difficult for him to cash out the materials he had collected and his phone was already receiving reminders from the bank to pay his debts...
Fang Heng looked over the contract carefully.
Huh?
Fang Heng was a little surprised.
The contract was too good!
The conditions were better than expected and it made him wonder if this was a trap.
30,000 yuan a month, no mandatory working hours, any materials, equipment, skills and other rewards that the player obtained in the game need not be given to the company.
The only thing he needed to do was to complete the company's performance appraisal.
If his performance was not up to par, there would be a deduction from his bonus, and in the worst-case scenario, he would be fired.
There was also a bonus?
Fang Heng thought to himself that since he would only be working here for a month, he would first take out 30,000 yuan to resolve the urgent matter.
He would just resign after a month.
Since he was accepted into the company, he could also see if he had a chance to obtain the company's S-level talent enhancement mission...
He would temporarily endure it and work as a worker for a month.
"Okay."
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng signed his name on the contract.

"Mr Jimmy is an important customer of Phoenix Sound Company. President Qin hopes that you can start work immediately and ensure Mr Jimmy's safety in the game during this period. This will be part of your internship performance evaluation.
Fang Heng nodded and thought that this job was pretty good.
As long as Jimmy didn't run around and cause trouble in the game, it wouldn't be difficult for him to fill his stomach and guarantee his safety.
This way, he could save a lot of time and make use of it to develop in the game.
It was that simple and he could earn 30,000 yuan a month?
Fang Heng suddenly had a feeling that making money was very simple.
"I'll take you to the business department first. Your accommodation hasn't been arranged yet. Can I arrange for you to stay in the hotel next door for the next few days?"
"Of course!"
After all, it was a big company and he had free accommodation in a hotel.
Fang Heng muttered in his heart.
In the gaming business department on the third floor.
The lady from the human resource department had just led Fang Heng into the door when an unkempt and unshaven young man walked up to them.
"You're finally here, my Miss Angel, is he the newcomer? I've been waiting for a long time. We're short of manpower. What's your level? What district are you from?"
As he spoke, he was sizing up Fang Heng from time to time.
"No, no, no. If your project team needs people, you have to report it to the higher-ups. This person isn't for you. President Qin has temporarily let him stay with you for two weeks."
"What do you mean? He's not my person? Let me tell you, now that District 8 is open, we're in urgent need of manpower. You know how urgent this situation is. Besides, I've already made the report..."
"Aiya, aiya, don't tell me that. Fang Heng has a special mission from the boss, it's..."
The human resource lady was just about to explain when her phone rang again.
"Okay, okay, I'll be right there." She hung up the phone and pushed Shen Qing in front of Fang Heng.

"Fang Heng, this is Shen Qing. You'll be working here temporarily for a few days. Follow him to familiarize yourself with the environment. Just remember to complete the mission that the boss gave you. When the boss is available, she'll talk to you face to face."
After saying that, the young lady hurriedly ran away.
"Sigh!" Shen Qing sighed and patted Fang Heng's shoulder. "Are you new? I'm Shen Qing, the team leader of Team 3 of the business department. Which server are you from?"
"Server 8."
As Fang Heng spoke, he looked around.
The interior of the entire office of Team 3 was very big. There was a row of game cabins on one side of the room and one-third of them were running.
Most of the employees were sitting in front of their computers, busying themselves with their work. They looked like they were in dire stress.

"Oh! It's also a new server. It must be very busy." Shen Qing nodded and then he pointed at a row of advanced gaming cabins in the room. "Team 3 doesn't have so many rules. The seven gaming cabins here are still new. You can choose one and use it as you like. If you want to eat, it's on the seventh floor and the eighth floor..."
"Brother Qing! Come and take a look. There's a big deal in District 7! The client is rushing us!"
"I'm coming! I'm coming!" Shen Qing shouted and said to Fang Heng, "Take a look first. If you have any problems, feel free to look for me."
Fang Heng nodded silently.
The business department seemed very busy.
It was good that no one cared about him.
Just now, the secretary said that he would start work today, so it was time to go to work, right?
Playing games was part of his job scope.
After all, the early stages of the game were the most pressing and they could not be delayed.
Fang Heng walked to a new game cabin, opened it and directly entered the game world.
There were two ways to enter the King of Gods' game. One was to enter the game voluntarily, using items like the game cabin to enter the game.
The game cabin was set with an emergency button. Once it was pressed, the player in the game would receive a prompt.
The other option was to join the game involuntarily. The player would be pulled into the game world by the King of Gods' game and disappear from the real world.
This method was considered extremely dangerous.
Opening his eyes, Fang Heng appeared in the system shelter again.
Inside the cabin, wood, stones and other materials were randomly thrown on the ground.
A zombie staggered into the cabin and threw the collected materials on the ground one by one.
Seeing this, Fang Heng rubbed his temples as he experienced a little headache.
Liu Lin and Liao Bufan were out.

According to their plan, this morning, Liu Lin and Liao Bufan would start to search the area on the west side of the cabin. They would find out the situation there and see if they could find a suitable place to build a shelter.
Jimmy was still in the real world just like him.
In this way, there was no one in the entire shelter. If someone came in and saw the materials lying all over the ground, wouldn't they be laughing in their dreams?
He needed to build a shelter as soon as possible to store the materials and prevent other survivors from intruding.
Fang Heng opened the game log to check.
[Hint: During the hacking, your zombie team collected firewood*221, nails*7, instant noodles*1, parts*1, insulator*1, turbid water*4, bird eggs*3, bricks*7...]
Eh? Found instant noodles!
Fang Heng summoned all the zombies to stop the hack and return to the cabin. He then made himself another bowl of instant noodles.
Twenty minutes later, Fang Heng walked out of the cabin after eating and drinking his fill.
Behind him were ten zombies holding wooden spears.
Their combat ability was not bad.
In the morning, Fang Heng had already circled the cabin a few times, clearing away the zombies that were wandering around and farming some evolution crystal fragments.

Perhaps it was because they were in the early stages of the game, but the King of Gods' game was more merciful. There were not many zombies that had resurrected around the cabin, and even after circling twice, he only managed to obtain two crystal fragments.
"Forget it. Let's put aside killing the zombies for now and move on to the next step of the plan."
Nails!
To build a player's shelter, there were two types of materials that were essential.
Wooden planks and nails.
Fang Heng had zombies as coolies, so it was not a big problem for him to make and collect wooden planks. On the other hand, it was a little difficult to obtain nails.
It was very difficult to satisfy the demand of building a large shelter by simply collecting materials in the wild and trading with players.
The other way to obtain them was to make them themselves.
This would require cast iron and a furnace.

The materials needed to make a furnace were very complicated and they also needed to rely on extremely high skill levels. It was almost impossible to do so in the early stages, so they could only buy them from the apocalypse merchant camps.

"You're finally here, my Miss Angel, is he the newcomer?
I've been waiting for a long time.
We're short of manpower.
What's your level?
What district are you from?"
As he spoke, he was sizing up Fang Heng from time to time.
"No, no, no.
If your project team needs people, you have to report it to the higher-ups.
This person isn't for you.
President Qin has temporarily let him stay with you for two weeks."
"What do you mean?
He's not my person?
Let me tell you, now that District 8 is open, we're in urgent need of manpower.
You know how urgent this situation is.
Besides, I've already made the report..."
"Aiya, aiya, don't tell me that.
Fang Heng has a special mission from the boss, it's..."
The human resource lady was just about to explain when her phone rang again.
"Okay, okay, I'll be right there." She hung up the phone and pushed Shen Qing in front of Fang Heng.
"Fang Heng, this is Shen Qing.
You'll be working here temporarily for a few days.
Follow him to familiarize yourself with the environment.
Just remember to complete the mission that the boss gave you.
When the boss is available, she'll talk to you face to face."
After saying that, the young lady hurriedly ran away.
"Sigh!" Shen Qing sighed and patted Fang Heng's shoulder.
"Are you new?
I'm Shen Qing, the team leader of Team 3 of the business department.
Which server are you from?"
"Server 8."
As Fang Heng spoke, he looked around.
The interior of the entire office of Team 3 was very big.
There was a row of game cabins on one side of the room and one-third of them were running.
Most of the employees were sitting in front of their computers, busying themselves with their work.
They looked like they were in dire stress.
"Oh!
It's also a new server.
It must be very busy." Shen Qing nodded and then he pointed at a row of advanced gaming cabins in the room.
"Team 3 doesn't have so many rules.
The seven gaming cabins here are still new.
You can choose one and use it as you like.
If you want to eat, it's on the seventh floor and the eighth floor..."
"Brother Qing!
Come and take a look.
There's a big deal in District 7!
The client is rushing us!"
"I'm coming!
I'm coming!" Shen Qing shouted and said to Fang Heng, "Take a look first.
If you have any problems, feel free to look for me."
Fang Heng nodded silently.
The business department seemed very busy.
It was good that no one cared about him.
Just now, the secretary said that he would start work today, so it was time to go to work, right?
Playing games was part of his job scope.
After all, the early stages of the game were the most pressing and they could not be delayed.
Fang Heng walked to a new game cabin, opened it and directly entered the game world.
There were two ways to enter the King of Gods' game.
One was to enter the game voluntarily, using items like the game cabin to enter the game.
The game cabin was set with an emergency button.
Once it was pressed, the player in the game would receive a prompt.
The other option was to join the game involuntarily.
The player would be pulled into the game world by the King of Gods' game and disappear from the real world.
This method was considered extremely dangerous.
Opening his eyes, Fang Heng appeared in the system shelter again.
Inside the cabin, wood, stones and other materials were randomly thrown on the ground.
A zombie staggered into the cabin and threw the collected materials on the ground one by one.
Seeing this, Fang Heng rubbed his temples as he experienced a little headache.
Liu Lin and Liao Bufan were out.
According to their plan, this morning, Liu Lin and Liao Bufan would start to search the area on the west side of the cabin.
They would find out the situation there and see if they could find a suitable place to build a shelter.
Jimmy was still in the real world just like him.
In this way, there was no one in the entire shelter.
If someone came in and saw the materials lying all over the ground, wouldn't they be laughing in their dreams?
He needed to build a shelter as soon as possible to store the materials and prevent other survivors from intruding.
Fang Heng opened the game log to check.
[Hint: During the hacking, your zombie team collected firewood*221, nails*7, instant noodles*1, parts*1, insulator*1, turbid water*4, bird eggs*3, bricks*7...]
Eh?
Found instant noodles!
Fang Heng summoned all the zombies to stop the hack and return to the cabin.
He then made himself another bowl of instant noodles.
Twenty minutes later, Fang Heng walked out of the cabin after eating and drinking his fill.
Behind him were ten zombies holding wooden spears.
Their combat ability was not bad.
In the morning, Fang Heng had already circled the cabin a few times, clearing away the zombies that were wandering around and farming some evolution crystal fragments.
Perhaps it was because they were in the early stages of the game, but the King of Gods' game was more merciful.
There were not many zombies that had resurrected around the cabin, and even after circling twice, he only managed to obtain two crystal fragments.
"Forget it.
Let's put aside killing the zombies for now and move on to the next step of the plan."
Nails!
To build a player's shelter, there were two types of materials that were essential.
Wooden planks and nails.
Fang Heng had zombies as coolies, so it was not a big problem for him to make and collect wooden planks.
On the other hand, it was a little difficult to obtain nails.
It was very difficult to satisfy the demand of building a large shelter by simply collecting materials in the wild and trading with players.
The other way to obtain them was to make them themselves.
This would require cast iron and a furnace.
The materials needed to make a furnace were very complicated and they also needed to rely on extremely high skill levels.
It was almost impossible to do so in the early stages, so they could only buy them from the apocalypse merchant camps.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Apocalypse Merchant
paragraphs: Fang Heng turned on his survival radio and used it to send messages to nearby players.
"20 survival points for the location of the apocalypse merchant camp. If you know anything, send me a private message."
A few scattered messages appeared.
"What the heck? 20 survival points? Boss is so rich?"
"What is this? Who doesn't know how to brag? I even have 100 points."
"Brother, you didn't just spend your time killing all the zombies in one day, right?"
"What are you pretending for? If you can get 20 survival points, I'll chop off my head and kick it like a ball."
"2 survival points for a bottle of water."
"What are you thinking about?"
"It's okay if there's no water. There's a stream in the forest. Just drink it and you'll be done."
Following that, the topic was completely changed.
Fang Heng was speechless when he saw the players' feedback.
Just as he was about to turn off the radio, a private message from a player popped up in his personal message.
"Brother, I know the location of the apocalypse merchant, but you have to give me some points first."
Fang Heng glanced at the other player's ID - Lu Yu.
He immediately transferred 20 survival points through the system.
When Lu Yu received the survival points transferred by Fang Heng, he was a little surprised at first.
There was such a powerful player who could transfer 20 points to him without even blinking an eye?
Lu Yu's thought about it and he quickly understood that the other party belonged to an organized team.
"Brother, you're very straightforward. The apocalypse merchant camp's coordinates are at (21232,29123). It's very safe there. I've just been there."

Fang Heng looked at the map. The coordinates of the apocalypse merchant camp that the other party had marked were pitch-black. The distance wasn't too far and it would only take about half an hour to get there.
He would go over and take a look first.
Fang Heng blended into the zombie crowd and headed toward the location of the apocalypse merchant camp.
More than ten zombie clones were gathered together and they could completely crush ordinary zombies.
If they encountered ordinary zombies, they would be pierced into a sieve by wooden spears.
If ordinary players encountered them along the way, they would mistakenly think that they had encountered a small zombie crowd and run far away, not daring to cause any trouble.
After walking for nearly half an hour and crossing a hill, Fang Heng stopped in his tracks.
He saw it!
The apocalypse merchant camp!
In the zombie apocalypse game, players were not the only survivors. There were also a few NPCs and aborigines. Some of the NPCs were staying in the apocalypse merchant camp.
Players could talk to them and interact with them. If they were lucky enough, they might even be able to trick an NPC mercenary to return as a bodyguard.
Other than that, players could receive quests from the apocalypse merchant and exchange survival points for materials.
Fang Heng had his zombie clones stay on standby and enter the camp alone.
After all, the zombie clone was also a zombie. It was restricted by the system. Once it got close to the apocalypse merchant camp, it might be attacked by the people from the camp.
In the camp, the bearded NPC warmly greeted the newcomer, Fang Heng.
"Hey, survivor, you're lucky to have met me during the apocalypse."
"You're the 18th survivor I've seen here, so you don't get any rewards."
"This is my new camp. It's pretty good, right? I can guarantee your safety here, but it's very cheap to charge 500 survival points for one night."
Fang Heng ignored the NPC's initial lines and nodded, "Is there any mission for me to do?"
"You came at the right time. We just set up a gathering point here, and there are many things that we need help with. See if any missions are suitable for you."
Fang Heng opened the mission panel.
Rows of mission requirements were refreshed.
Fang Heng's eyes were immediately attracted by the first row of missions.
Clearing the zombies in the lumberyard camp.
Difficulty: SSS
Description: Clear all the surviving zombies in the target location.
Reward: 4000 survival points
(Description: As the time in the game world increases, the difficulty and reward of this quest will gradually decrease.)
It was an SSS-level mission?!
The memory of the previous owner of the body had been in the game for two years and the highest difficulty level of the quest that he saw was only at S-level.
Notwithstanding whether he could complete it or not, Fang Heng never had the chance to get an S-level mission before!
The new server was not bad and no one had ever done an SSS-level mission!
Fang Heng lowered his head and reviewed the mission requirements again.
Kill zombies?
Ah! It was just the right time!
Fang Heng was relieved. The main purpose of this SSS-level mission was to kill zombies. It was very compatible with him. He could earn survival points and also farm evolution crystal fragments.
"I accept this mission."
"Oh? It's a very challenging mission!"

"There's a lumberyard camp by the river. There are a lot of zombies there. If I let them do whatever they want, they might pose a threat to my camp. I need you to completely clear out the zombies in the lumberyard camp."
"Are you sure you want to accept this mission? You have three days to complete this mission."
"Yes."
"Very good. Look, this is the first time we've met. To ensure that you can complete it, you need to give me a deposit. I think 167 survival points should be it. You would agree, right?"
"Don't worry, after completing the mission, I will return the deposit in full.
167 points were exactly what Fang Heng currently had left.
Fang Heng knew that this was one of the settings of the game.
Hidden score.
The King of the Gods had an initial hidden score for each player.
Every time a mission was completed, the King of the Gods would evaluate the overall completion of the mission and update the hidden score.
The player would receive a mission that was more difficult than the hidden score, and the apocalypse merchant would propose to collect a deposit.

The greater the difference between the difficulty of the mission and the hidden score of the player, the more the deposit would be collected. However, the highest deposit would not exceed all the survival points of the player.
Once the mission failed, the deposit would not be returned.
"Deal."
[Hint: 167 survival points have been deducted from you.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission of the apocalypse merchant, Vettel, to completely clear the zombie horde in the lumberyard camp.]
[Hint: During the apocalypse, one person's power is too small. You can try to seek help from other survivors to complete the mission together.]
"I wish you success. Also, I have to remind you that the zombies there are quite troublesome. You can't easily finish them off by yourself. You need to find some help. Don't die in there."
"Thank you."
Fang Heng left the apocalypse merchant camp without looking back.
Find help?
No, he was going to farm alone!

The early-stage players did not even have enough food to eat. On one hand, they had to seize the time to collect materials to survive, on the other hand, they had to think of ways to strengthen the shelter provided by the system. They did not have the time to kill the zombies.
So what if they found help? How much contribution could they make to clearing the camp?
The early players' combat power was very low.
Fang Heng was different from ordinary players.
Not only did he have the spare energy to kill zombies, but he was also very eager to kill zombies to obtain the evolution crystal fragments.
While he was in thought, Fang Heng had already left the survival camp. He happened to notice two survivors walking toward the apocalypse merchant's direction.
The two parties looked at each other and did not say anything. They just brushed past each other.
Five minutes later, a scream came from the survival camp.
"What the hell! The SSS-level mission was taken away by someone."
"Is he crazy?"
"He might be a newbie. He didn't understand the rules and directly accepted the mission."
"You're right."
Lu Yu nodded, but his head was filled with questions.
The person who accepted the mission wouldn't be the big boss who spent 20 survival points to ask him for the location of the camp, right?
No way. No matter how powerful he is, he won't be able to clear all the zombies in that area.
Thinking about the scene he had seen before, Lu Yu felt his scalp go numb.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Clearing the lumberyard
paragraphs: The lumberyard camp was not far from the apocalypse merchant camp.
Fifteen minutes later, Fang Heng had reached the outside of the lumberyard camp.
He hid in a bush and observed in the dark.
At first glance, he saw hundreds of zombies occupying the lumberyard camp.
The area was densely packed and the whimpers of the zombies filled his eardrums. Anyone who saw this scene would feel their scalps go numb.
Fang Heng didn't expect that there would be so many zombies.
He rubbed his hands excitedly.
"Just in time. This will give me a chance to collect evolution crystal fragments!"
Fang Heng waved his hand and the ten zombies who had been following behind him immediately took action.
They slowly walked into the lumberyard camp with wooden spears in their hands.
The zombies in the camp didn't sense the ten 'intruders'. They just stood there foolishly.
"Chi!"
The zombie clone raised its spear and stabbed into the back of a zombie in front of it.
The zombie that was stabbed by the wooden spear slowly turned its head and glanced at its kind of zombie expressionlessly.
Ordinary zombies couldn't feel pain. Their minds were only occupied by the basic desire to eat meat. They wouldn't understand, nor would they think about why another zombie would suddenly stab them.
It continued to stand there in a daze.
The zombies in this lumberyard camp were like lambs waiting to be slaughtered. They stood there silently, being attacked by Fang Heng's zombie clones time and time again until they died.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a weak zombie. 1 survival point.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a strong zombie. 3 survival points.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a strong zombie, 3 survival points, obtained evolution crystal fragment*1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed...]
At this moment, Fang Heng was hiding in the bushes at the entrance of the camp, quietly reading the messages in the game log.
Hack, this game was awesome!
At first, watching zombies kill monsters was indeed a little exciting.
But after the initial excitement faded, Fang Heng, who was a little bored, sat down on the ground, took out a can of canned fruit from his backpack and started to eat.
It can't be helped, his talent skill was just too powerful.
In the zombie apocalypse world, getting a zombie clone as your talent was really useful!
Killing monsters without suffering any injuries!
Especially after the number of zombie clones was growing in magnitude! The efficiency of killing monsters had greatly increased.
If it was another apocalyptic world like the wasteland apocalypse, the slow-moving zombie clones would have already been cut into pieces by the mutated creatures.
It wouldn't have been like now, where the silly zombies were all standing where they were and letting you kill them.
[Hint: You have completed the clearing of the camp.]

[Hint: You have completed the mission of clearing the lumberyard camp. Please return to the apocalypse merchant camp as soon as possible and look for the apocalypse merchant Vettel to receive the mission reward.]
Three hours had passed by the time the game notification sounded.
It took three hours to strike those restless zombies to death. It was conceivable how time and effort ordinary players would have to take to clear out the zombie camp.
The zombie clones walked out of the camp one by one and threw the evolution crystal fragment that they dropped from killing the zombies in front of Fang Heng.
[Hint: You have obtained evolution crystal fragment*47.]
"I'm rich, I'm rich!" he thought to himself gleefully.
Fang Heng grabbed a bunch of shiny evolution crystal fragments from the ground and crushed them in his hand.
"Bang!"
A thick blood mist exploded in his palm. Fang Heng felt a weak force enter his body through his palm.
"Bang!!"
"Bang! Bang!!"
The blood mist exploded one after another.
[Hint: Your character's level has risen to level 5.]
The soil behind him stirred and five newly resurrected zombie clones joined the team.
Fang Heng was quite satisfied. His zombie army had expanded by one-third and its combat power had increased greatly.
After players reached level 5, normal evolution crystal fragments could no longer provide experience points. They needed a higher level of complete evolution crystals to upgrade further.
The method to obtain a complete evolution crystal was rather troublesome. Under normal circumstances, only elite monsters had a chance of dropping it.

There were other ways to obtain a complete evolution crystal. For example, the apocalypse camp had a small probability of selling a small number of complete evolution crystals. Some players could use special skills or talents to reassemble the fragments to obtain a complete evolution crystal.
Currently, it was still a little difficult to obtain a complete evolution crystal. Fang Heng would not consider it for the time being.
Fang Heng put the remaining 13 pieces of the evolution crystal into his backpack and led the zombie group into the abandoned lumberyard to collect materials.
10 minutes later, Fang Heng was surrounded by a pile of materials.

[Hint: Your zombie group has searched the lumberyard camp. You have obtained small barrels of gasoline*2, firewood*21, cooking pot*1, steel logging axe*33, log*291, abandoned parts*23, worn-out mountain bike*1, scrap material*2, rags*21, frozen dumplings*10, lumberyard worker's jacket*24...]
Good stuff!
A mountain bike!
Fang Heng's eyes lit up!
A treasure that could greatly increase the speed of exploration in the wild! A transportation tool!
In the forest environment, sometimes a mountain bike was even more useful than a military truck! It could greatly reduce the time to return home!
There was also the steel logging axe!
A large amount of wood was needed to build the shelter.
With the steel logging axe, the zombie clone could harvest wood more efficiently!
"I'm rich, I'm really rich!"
There were still so many finished logs, which saved him a lot of logging time.
Gasoline!
With generators, electricity could be generated, and the vehicle also needed gasoline as fuel. Whether it was in the early, middle or late stages, gasoline was an extremely important material!
Frozen dumplings!
That's great! They were going to be tasty!
Eh? There were even clothes?
Most of the ordinary clothes in the game did not have any attributes.
Fang Heng took a look at the clothing description.
Item: Lumberyard jacket
Description: When worn, it can increase defence by 1 point. (wearing a lumberyard jacket and lumberyard pants at the same time can increase logging efficiency by an additional 25%.)
1 defence point was not bad, but the suit was too ugly.
Fang Heng thought for a moment, then waved his hand to call the zombie clone to come over and let it put on the suit.
"Not bad, not bad, it fits very well."
After putting on the lumberyard suit, the zombie didn't feel out of place at all. It even gained 1 defence point.
Although 1 defence point was better than nothing for the zombie, the extra 25% of logging efficiency provided by the suit was what Fang Heng wanted.
The harvest after clearing out the lumberyard camp was amazing.
Looking at the materials piled up on the ground, Fang Heng began to worry again.
His backpack was not big enough now, so he could not bring all these things back at once.
It was going to be dark in half an hour, so it was not realistic to go back and forth between the shelter and the lumberyard camp.
Helplessly, Fang Heng could only bring some valuable food and logging axes, temporarily throwing the logs and other materials that were heavier on the ground.
The rest of the materials could not be wasted. After sunset tonight, he would let the zombies carry them back to the system shelter again and again.
Fang Heng packed his backpack full to the brim and rode his bicycle to the apocalypse merchant camp to report about the completion of the mission.

[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed a strong zombie, 3 survival points, obtained evolution crystal fragment*1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has killed...]
At this moment, Fang Heng was hiding in the bushes at the entrance of the camp, quietly reading the messages in the game log.
Hack, this game was awesome!
At first, watching zombies kill monsters was indeed a little exciting.
But after the initial excitement faded, Fang Heng, who was a little bored, sat down on the ground, took out a can of canned fruit from his backpack and started to eat.
It can't be helped, his talent skill was just too powerful.
In the zombie apocalypse world, getting a zombie clone as your talent was really useful!
Killing monsters without suffering any injuries!
Especially after the number of zombie clones was growing in magnitude!
The efficiency of killing monsters had greatly increased.
If it was another apocalyptic world like the wasteland apocalypse, the slow-moving zombie clones would have already been cut into pieces by the mutated creatures.
It wouldn't have been like now, where the silly zombies were all standing where they were and letting you kill them.
[Hint: You have completed the clearing of the camp.]
[Hint: You have completed the mission of clearing the lumberyard camp.
Please return to the apocalypse merchant camp as soon as possible and look for the apocalypse merchant Vettel to receive the mission reward.]
Three hours had passed by the time the game notification sounded.
It took three hours to strike those restless zombies to death.
It was conceivable how time and effort ordinary players would have to take to clear out the zombie camp.
The zombie clones walked out of the camp one by one and threw the evolution crystal fragment that they dropped from killing the zombies in front of Fang Heng.
[Hint: You have obtained evolution crystal fragment*47.]
"I'm rich, I'm rich!" he thought to himself gleefully.
Fang Heng grabbed a bunch of shiny evolution crystal fragments from the ground and crushed them in his hand.
"Bang!"
A thick blood mist exploded in his palm.
Fang Heng felt a weak force enter his body through his palm.
"Bang!!"
"Bang!
Bang!!"
The blood mist exploded one after another.
[Hint: Your character's level has risen to level 5.]
The soil behind him stirred and five newly resurrected zombie clones joined the team.
Fang Heng was quite satisfied.
His zombie army had expanded by one-third and its combat power had increased greatly.
After players reached level 5, normal evolution crystal fragments could no longer provide experience points.
They needed a higher level of complete evolution crystals to upgrade further.
The method to obtain a complete evolution crystal was rather troublesome.
Under normal circumstances, only elite monsters had a chance of dropping it.
There were other ways to obtain a complete evolution crystal.
For example, the apocalypse camp had a small probability of selling a small number of complete evolution crystals.
Some players could use special skills or talents to reassemble the fragments to obtain a complete evolution crystal.
Currently, it was still a little difficult to obtain a complete evolution crystal.
Fang Heng would not consider it for the time being.
Fang Heng put the remaining 13 pieces of the evolution crystal into his backpack and led the zombie group into the abandoned lumberyard to collect materials.
10 minutes later, Fang Heng was surrounded by a pile of materials.
[Hint: Your zombie group has searched the lumberyard camp.

You have obtained small barrels of gasoline*2, firewood*21, cooking pot*1, steel logging axe*33, log*291, abandoned parts*23, worn-out mountain bike*1, scrap material*2, rags*21, frozen dumplings*10, lumberyard worker's jacket*24...]
Good stuff!
A mountain bike!
Fang Heng's eyes lit up!
A treasure that could greatly increase the speed of exploration in the wild!
A transportation tool!
In the forest environment, sometimes a mountain bike was even more useful than a military truck!
It could greatly reduce the time to return home!
There was also the steel logging axe!
A large amount of wood was needed to build the shelter.
With the steel logging axe, the zombie clone could harvest wood more efficiently!
"I'm rich, I'm really rich!"
There were still so many finished logs, which saved him a lot of logging time.
Gasoline!
With generators, electricity could be generated, and the vehicle also needed gasoline as fuel.
Whether it was in the early, middle or late stages, gasoline was an extremely important material!
Frozen dumplings!
That's great!
They were going to be tasty!
Eh?
There were even clothes?
Most of the ordinary clothes in the game did not have any attributes.
Fang Heng took a look at the clothing description.
Item: Lumberyard jacket
Description: When worn, it can increase defence by 1 point. (wearing a lumberyard jacket and lumberyard pants at the same time can increase logging efficiency by an additional 25%.)
1 defence point was not bad, but the suit was too ugly.
Fang Heng thought for a moment, then waved his hand to call the zombie clone to come over and let it put on the suit.
"Not bad, not bad, it fits very well."
After putting on the lumberyard suit, the zombie didn't feel out of place at all.
It even gained 1 defence point.
Although 1 defence point was better than nothing for the zombie, the extra 25% of logging efficiency provided by the suit was what Fang Heng wanted.
The harvest after clearing out the lumberyard camp was amazing.
Looking at the materials piled up on the ground, Fang Heng began to worry again.
His backpack was not big enough now, so he could not bring all these things back at once.
It was going to be dark in half an hour, so it was not realistic to go back and forth between the shelter and the lumberyard camp.
Helplessly, Fang Heng could only bring some valuable food and logging axes, temporarily throwing the logs and other materials that were heavier on the ground.
The rest of the materials could not be wasted.
After sunset tonight, he would let the zombies carry them back to the system shelter again and again.
Fang Heng packed his backpack full to the brim and rode his bicycle to the apocalypse merchant camp to report about the completion of the mission.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Hidden Mission
paragraphs: "Oh? You completed the mission so quickly?!"
In the apocalypse merchant camp, Big Beardy was surprised to see Fang Heng return so soon.
"Very good, young survivor. You have done very well! Your performance has impressed me."
[Hint: You have completed the mission to clear the lumberyard camp. You have received the praise of the apocalypse merchant Vettel.]
[Hint: You have received 4,167 survival points.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Vettel has increased.]
[Hint: Because you completed the mission in a very short period, your friendship with the apocalypse merchant has increased significantly.]
"It's rare to see such an outstanding young man like you. Recently, a few of my friends are looking for someone like you. Have you heard of the Dark Knights?"
Dark Knights?!
It was a hidden mission!
Fang Heng was both surprised and happy.
His hidden score had reached the Dark Knights so quickly!

In the memories of this body, the Dark Knights were related to the main storyline mission of the game world. Only players with a hidden score higher than a certain level in the King of Gods' game were qualified to obtain it, moreover, there were quite harsh hidden trigger conditions.
In the past, Fang Heng even heard rumours in the gaming club that the Dark Knights were related to clearing the zombie apocalypse world.
"It seems that you've heard about it. The Dark Knights are an organization that was established after the disaster. They've been looking for ways to save the entire human race."
"An old friend of mine is a member of the Dark Knights. If you're interested, I can recommend you to join the Dark Knights."
"I'm very interested!"
"Very good. The Dark Knights need strong survivors, so you need to make some achievements to prove your capabilities."
"What do you need me to do?"

"There's a small town 200 kilometres away from here. There's a T-virus serum in the director's office on the third floor of the town's Community Hospital. I hope you can find it and bring it back safely to me."
"After completing the mission, I will take you to find the guide of the Dark Knights."
[Hint: Player has triggered the mission - find the T-virus serum.]
Mission name: Find the T-virus serum.

Mission description: Find the T-virus serum and hand it over to the apocalypse merchant Vettel (you can find the T-virus serum in the director's office on the third floor of the Community Hospital in Hope Town. You can also find the T-virus serum through other means).
Hint: As time passes, the anti-virus serum in Hope Town may be taken away or destroyed by the survivors ahead of time.
Mission time limit: 60 days
"The difficulty has increased so much all of a sudden?
Fang Heng frowned and muttered to himself in a low voice.
During the apocalypse, there were a lot of zombies in the city. The probability of encountering mutated zombies in the city was also higher, and the danger was greatly increased.
In his original plan, the exploration of the city would at least be considered after the construction of the shelter was completed.
Fortunately, this mission gave him a full 60 days to complete. In theory, he only needed to find the serum before the other players.
This was the best chance for him to come into contact with the main storyline mission of the game world!
Fang Heng analyzed briefly and immediately chose to accept the mission.
There was no penalty for failure anyway!
"I will help you get the serum."

"I admire your confidence, survivor. I wish you success." Big Beardy nodded in approval. "Another suggestion, take advantage of the fact that the anti-virus serum has not been destroyed. The sooner you get it, the better."
Fang Heng understood that Big Beardy was hinting at him. The faster he completed the mission, the higher the reward provided by the game.
However...
He really couldn't complete the mission in such a short time!!
"Thank you." Fang Heng smiled bitterly and continued, "Also, I want to exchange for some materials."

After completing the mission, the 4,167 survival points reward was added to his account. Together with the 1,300 points which he obtained from clearing the zombies, Fang Heng now had a huge sum of 5,520 survival points!
The New World had just opened two days ago. Even an advanced gaming guild would not be able to raise such a huge sum of money.
"Of course, you can. The materials here are cheap and good. In addition, you've just helped me a lot. I can give you a friendship price."
"Thank you."
Fang Heng knew that this was the benefit of increasing his favorability. He could enjoy a small discount when he exchanged for materials.
Big Beardy waved his hand and an exchange list appeared in front of Fang Heng's eyes.
Fang Heng quickly browsed through the sales catalogue.

The apocalypse merchant provided a variety of materials in the exchange list. In addition to food, there were also some sophisticated high-grade materials, and even guns and ammunition were available for sale.
However, the price of guns was just as shocking.
Originally, Fang Heng only wanted to buy a few furnaces. However, when he saw the modified motorcycles on the list, he immediately hesitated.
The modified motorcycles had a detachable two-wheeled rack behind them, which could store a large number of materials.
The modified motorcycles were excellent tools for both travelling alone and transporting supplies!
The only drawback was that they burned oil! But he had just found two tanks of oil from the lumberyard camp...
Fang Heng was in a dilemma.
He wanted both of them!
However, in terms of price, he could only buy three furnaces or a modified motorcycle.
If only he had a little more survival points.
"What? You don't like these things?"
Seeing Fang Heng's distressed expression, Vettel thought that he was not satisfied, so he waved his hand with a smile and opened another exchange column in front of Fang Heng.

"Then take a look at this place. These are my private collections, and they are generally not open to the public. In addition, you can only exchange the materials here at the original price, and you are not allowed to have discounts."
Fang Heng's eyes lit up.
The apocalypse merchant had a hidden exchange column? This was the first time he had heard of it.
Big Beardy! He hid it quite well!
Seeing the goods provided by the apocalypse merchant in the hidden exchange list, Fang Heng's breathing became a little hurried for a moment.
There was a skill book for sale!!
What motorcycle! What forged furnace! Their combined value could not even be compared to this skill book!
Fang Heng reached out his hand and tapped on a skill manual. He looked at Vettel excitedly, "Uncle, I want this."
Item: Apocalypse survival - strength training
Type: Skill book (player has not mastered this skill)

Description: After learning this skill, you will be able to master the skill - strength training. Each level will increase the player's basic strength points by 0.2 points. This skill can be upgraded to level 20 (the skill level does not exceed the current player's level).
"Of course, you can. It's a very smart choice. You only need 1500 points to buy this skill book. It can help you to provide a decent fighting strength in your quest for survival."
Vettel shrugged. "What's better than investing in yourself?"
In the King of Gods' game, players could not obtain any attribute gains just by levelling up.
Therefore, a skill book like this had already been sold for millions in the real world!
Fang Heng licked his lips and pointed at the remaining two skill books in the exchange list. "And these two, physical training and agility training. I'll take these two books as well."
"Okay, a total of 4,600 survival points."
[Hint: You have spent 4,600 survival points to purchase the following skill books on strength training, physical training and agility training.]

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Skill Books
paragraphs: After leaving the apocalypse merchant camp, Fang Heng almost could not hold back his laughter.
Several million!
Each of the three skill books in his hands could easily sell for several million!
Not to mention that this was a newly opened 'server'. After some time had passed, the price of the skill books would increase by several times!
Yesterday, Fang Heng was still worried about his bank debt. Now, a few million was within his reach!
Fang Heng put away the smile on his face and tapped the three skill books worth a few million on his head.
Without the slightest hesitation.
[Hint: You have learned the skill: apocalypse survival - strength training, apocalypse survival - agility training, apocalypse survival - physical training.]
"Isn't it just a few million? I'll earn more as time goes!" he thought.
The apocalypse merchant was right. Only by improving himself could he earn more money.
Fang Heng had a feeling that this game would completely change his fate.
Player: Fang Heng
Level: 5
Vitality: 100/100
Spirit: 100/100
Energy: 83/100
Strength: 5.2
Agility: 5.2
Physique: 5.2
Will: 5
Perception: 5
Intelligence: 5
Talent skill: Enhanced - super zombie clone
[Normal skill]
Skill: Strength training (Level 1)
Skill description: Increases strength attribute of the current skill level by 0.2*.
Skill: Physical training (Level 1)
Skill description: Increases the physical attribute of the current skill level by 0.2*.
Skill: Agility training (Level 1)
Skill description: Increases the agility attribute of the current skill level by 0.2*.
[Life skill]
Skill: Basic crafting (Level 1)
Skill description: Creates basic apocalypse survival items, increasing the skill level can increase the production speed and unlock more survival items.
Skill: Basic cooking (Level 1)
Skill description: You can cook delicious food, increasing the skill level can reduce the probability of cooking failure and slightly increase the taste of delicious food.
Fang Heng tried to clench his fist to feel the changes in his body.
It seemed like...
It seemed like he was a little too strong, right?
Damn it!
Why didn't he feel anything when he spent close to ten million yuan?
Seeing that the sky was getting darker, Fang Heng did not delay any longer. He rode his mountain bike back to the cabin so that he could study the books properly when he got back.
Inside the cabin.
Liao Bufan watched helplessly as Fang Heng opened the packages of quick-frozen dumplings and threw them into the pot.
He swallowed his saliva.
Fragrant!
It was too fragrant!
The fragrance went straight into his nose.
In comparison, the two baked potatoes in his hands were simply tasteless.
Raising his head, Liao Bufan said seriously, "Fang Heng, I've decided to work with you in the game from now on."
"Okay."
Fang Heng shrugged. He had one more tool man.
"You have to take care of the food!"
"Deal."
"Okay!"
Liao Bufan waved his fist excitedly!
Tonight, he had dumplings to eat.
Jimmy drank a mouthful of hot tea and said, "Fang Heng, I may not have much time in the game during the day, so I'll have to trouble you."
"Of course."
In his mind, Fang Heng added, "It's all work. After all, the monthly salary is 30,000 yuan."
"My talent attribute can make crossbows. Due to the limitation of my energy, I can't make many crossbows every day."
"Thank you, this thing is a great help!"
In the early stages of the game, crossbows were used for long-range attacks. Whether it was hunting, dealing with zombies or dealing with other hostile survivors, they were extremely effective.
In the game, Jimmy probably didn't want to reveal his real identity, so he didn't like to talk too much. He nodded slightly.
At first, Jimmy scoffed at Fang Heng's plan to build a shelter in the game.
But now he knew that the Phoenix Sound Company must be behind Fang Heng's plan of building the shelter, Jimmy didn't mind giving him a little help.
The dumplings were soon cooked.
Lacking bowls and chopsticks, they took the glass bottles and divided the dumplings.
While the outside players were still hungry, they could hide in the system shelter and cook dumplings to eat.
Thinking of this, Liao Bufan was particularly excited. He ate one dumpling at a time and didn't forget to give his opinion.
"It's a pity there's no vinegar. Otherwise, it would be perfect."
"You're the nosy one." Liu Lin cleared her throat and said, "Fang Heng, Liao Bufan and I have searched about 20 kilometres to the west during the day."

"We've noticed two system shelters. Players and survivors are living in them. I've talked to the survivors and I'm going to bring a small amount of food to trade with them for cast iron and nails tomorrow."
"Also, we've found an abandoned prison. There are a lot of zombies in there. It's scary.
Liao Bufan swallowed a dumpling and added, "I think this is the biggest threat. Once the zombies escape, we'll be implicated. We have to be careful."
Fang Heng sensed something and raised his head.
"Prison?"
"Yes, all the people in there are infected. I wanted to get closer to see if I could find some weapons in the prison."
"D*mn! As soon as I got closer, zombies swarmed out of the house. There were at least thousands of them. Fortunately, they were stopped by the barbed wire outside."
Liao Bufan shuddered in fear at the thought of it.
"I don't think the barbed wire is very reliable. Luckily, we were able to escape quickly."
Fang Heng nodded and said, "This is a good place to build a shelter."
"What?"
Liao Bufan was so stunned that he slowed down when putting the dumplings into his mouth.
He thought that Fang Heng must be crazy.
"Brother, don't tell me you want to build a shelter in the prison? Give up this unrealistic idea!"
"Why?"

Fang Heng raised his head and asked, "Don't you think the prison is good? With the prison as the outer defence and the primary shelter on the inner side, we can have double protection and double security. We can slowly expand in the future."
"Brother, stop fooling around."
"Building a shelter in the prison means that we need to fill up the outer prison."
"The prison is too big. It will cost us a lot of manpower and resources."
After going through his analysis, Liao Bufan stuffed a mouthful of dumplings into his mouth. He felt smug and was waiting for the others to compliment him.
But he didn't get that compliment.
After a long time, Jimmy drank a mouthful of soup and said, "Young man, we don't lack materials now."
Liao Bufan was speechless for a moment.
He glanced at the pile of materials that covered half of the wooden house and couldn't help but scratch his head.
"Alright, even so, how are you going to deal with the zombies in the prison?"
"Don't worry about that. I have a plan."
Fang Heng was confident.
Zombies?
Of course, they will all be stabbed to death!
"Fang Heng, you didn't see the situation back then. The prison is very big. There are at least three to four thousand zombies in there. It's not easy to deal with them."
"Yeah, I'll be careful."
Fang Heng remained calm on the surface, but in his heart, he was beaming with joy.
Three to four thousand zombies, that was seven to eight thousand survival points!
He hoped that there would be as many zombies as possible!
It would be best if he could gather ten thousand survival points and buy all the modified motorcycles and furnaces from the apocalypse merchant...
Liu Lin and Liao Bufan looked at each other. They saw the nonchalant look on Fang Heng's face.
Did he have a way to deal with zombies?

Jimmy drank a mouthful of hot tea and said, "Fang Heng, I may not have much time in the game during the day, so I'll have to trouble you."
"Of course."
In his mind, Fang Heng added, "It's all work.
After all, the monthly salary is 30,000 yuan."
"My talent attribute can make crossbows.
Due to the limitation of my energy, I can't make many crossbows every day."
"Thank you, this thing is a great help!"
In the early stages of the game, crossbows were used for long-range attacks.
Whether it was hunting, dealing with zombies or dealing with other hostile survivors, they were extremely effective.
In the game, Jimmy probably didn't want to reveal his real identity, so he didn't like to talk too much.
He nodded slightly.
At first, Jimmy scoffed at Fang Heng's plan to build a shelter in the game.
But now he knew that the Phoenix Sound Company must be behind Fang Heng's plan of building the shelter, Jimmy didn't mind giving him a little help.
The dumplings were soon cooked.
Lacking bowls and chopsticks, they took the glass bottles and divided the dumplings.
While the outside players were still hungry, they could hide in the system shelter and cook dumplings to eat.
Thinking of this, Liao Bufan was particularly excited.
He ate one dumpling at a time and didn't forget to give his opinion.
"It's a pity there's no vinegar.
Otherwise, it would be perfect."
"You're the nosy one." Liu Lin cleared her throat and said, "Fang Heng, Liao Bufan and I have searched about 20 kilometres to the west during the day."
"We've noticed two system shelters.
Players and survivors are living in them.
I've talked to the survivors and I'm going to bring a small amount of food to trade with them for cast iron and nails tomorrow."
"Also, we've found an abandoned prison.
There are a lot of zombies in there.
It's scary.
Liao Bufan swallowed a dumpling and added, "I think this is the biggest threat.
Once the zombies escape, we'll be implicated.
We have to be careful."
Fang Heng sensed something and raised his head.
"Prison?"
"Yes, all the people in there are infected.
I wanted to get closer to see if I could find some weapons in the prison."
"D*mn!
As soon as I got closer, zombies swarmed out of the house.
There were at least thousands of them.
Fortunately, they were stopped by the barbed wire outside."
Liao Bufan shuddered in fear at the thought of it.
"I don't think the barbed wire is very reliable.
Luckily, we were able to escape quickly."
Fang Heng nodded and said, "This is a good place to build a shelter."
"What?"
Liao Bufan was so stunned that he slowed down when putting the dumplings into his mouth.
He thought that Fang Heng must be crazy.
"Brother, don't tell me you want to build a shelter in the prison?
Give up this unrealistic idea!"
"Why?"
Fang Heng raised his head and asked, "Don't you think the prison is good?
With the prison as the outer defence and the primary shelter on the inner side, we can have double protection and double security.
We can slowly expand in the future."
"Brother, stop fooling around."
"Building a shelter in the prison means that we need to fill up the outer prison."
"The prison is too big.
It will cost us a lot of manpower and resources."
After going through his analysis, Liao Bufan stuffed a mouthful of dumplings into his mouth.
He felt smug and was waiting for the others to compliment him.
But he didn't get that compliment.
After a long time, Jimmy drank a mouthful of soup and said, "Young man, we don't lack materials now."
Liao Bufan was speechless for a moment.
He glanced at the pile of materials that covered half of the wooden house and couldn't help but scratch his head.
"Alright, even so, how are you going to deal with the zombies in the prison?"
"Don't worry about that.
I have a plan."
Fang Heng was confident.
Zombies?
Of course, they will all be stabbed to death!
"Fang Heng, you didn't see the situation back then.
The prison is very big.
There are at least three to four thousand zombies in there.
It's not easy to deal with them."
"Yeah, I'll be careful."
Fang Heng remained calm on the surface, but in his heart, he was beaming with joy.
Three to four thousand zombies, that was seven to eight thousand survival points!
He hoped that there would be as many zombies as possible!
It would be best if he could gather ten thousand survival points and buy all the modified motorcycles and furnaces from the apocalypse merchant...
Liu Lin and Liao Bufan looked at each other.
They saw the nonchalant look on Fang Heng's face.
Did he have a way to deal with zombies?

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Amazing Efficiency
paragraphs: "Fang Heng, do you think we should reinforce this shelter tomorrow? The system's shelter protection will be ineffective the day after tomorrow."
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a moment.
There was still a huge gap in the number of nails needed to build a personal shelter. Tomorrow, he would have to clean up the zombies inside the prison.
The construction of a player's shelter could not be completed in less than two or three days.
They would have to stay in this shabby place for the next few days.
Fang Heng did not want to be forcefully pulled online by the game when the shelter was under attack at night.
The reinforcement of the cabin had to be put on the agenda!
Fang Heng patted Liao Bufan on the shoulder and said, "Then, brother, I'll leave the reinforcement of the shelter to you. You'll reinforce the cabin tomorrow and watch over it."
"Okay."
Liao Bufan agreed and patted his chest proudly.

"I forgot to mention that my talent is reinforcement and maintenance, it increases the reinforcement efficiency by 20% and reduces the consumption of materials by 20%. This skill saves materials. Do you know that you've got a good deal by hiring me?"
"Creak!"
The sound of the wooden door being pushed open interrupted Liao Bufan's bragging.
A zombie in a lumberyard uniform staggered in from outside.
The people in the cabin turned their heads to look at the zombie.
The zombie clone threw the piles of logs from its backpack onto the ground.
It didn't care about the stares of the people. It turned around and left the cabin again.
[Hint: Your zombie has completed a round of material transportation. You have gained logs*10. You have gained a skill - physical training experience point +20.]
[Hint: Your zombie has started a new round of material transportation.]
Liao Bufan opened his mouth.
This time, he was completely in awe.
He could finally see that Fang Heng didn't lack materials at all!
Fang Heng didn't notice the change in Liao Bufan's expression. His attention was now focused on the game log.
Eh? The zombie clone could also provide experience points for skills!
This was a really good deal!
After eating and drinking his fill, Fang Heng logged off first.
At 8:30 pm, Phoenix Sound Gaming Company was still brightly lit.
Most of the game cabins in the office were running and there were still many employees busy in front of their computers.
Fang Heng saw that his game cabin had an eye-catching note and a room card stuck on it.
"Mr Fang Heng, I've already booked room 1602 for you in the hotel next door. This is your room card. If you have any questions, please contact me. My contact number is 1272..."
After getting the room card, he returned to the hotel and went to sleep!
After leaving the company, Fang Heng flipped through his phone.
There were more than ten missed calls on his phone. All of them were from Xia Xi.
Fang Heng slapped his forehead.
Oh no, he forgot to tell Xia Xi about the interview today.
Fang Heng was in a good mood now. He casually replied to her message.
"Thanks to you, I've passed. I'll treat you to a meal when the time comes."
Something was wrong!
After sending the message, Fang Heng felt a little regretful. This tone was not suitable for the cold and aloof image of the original owner of this body!
Before he could retract the message, Xia Xi immediately replied.
"Okay, I'll take note. Wait for me to come back."
Fang Heng was stunned.
"Where are you going?"
"To Seoul, to play a match."
What match?
Could it be that Xia Xi was also a professional player?
Why did he not have any impression of this matter?
Fang Heng scratched his head, feeling a little frustrated.
He noticed that he still had a lot of lost memories.
"Qin Shuran is my good friend, she just took over the company recently, you have to help her too."
"Help her? No way, does the boss still need my help? As long as she doesn't fire me."
Fang Heng cursed silently in his heart, but he still obediently replied with a message.
"Okay."
The hotel room was very big and it was far more comfortable than the small and run-down room from before.
After a tiring day, Fang Heng slept until dawn.
The next day, Fang Heng returned to Team 3's large office as usual.
Early in the morning, the office was bustling with people.
Many workers carried game cabins into the office.
"Hey! I said, you guys! Be careful! These are advanced game cabins, don't break them!"
"Move it aside, don't put it near the window."
Shen Qing commanded from the side and his voice sounded a little hoarse.
Noticing Fang Heng's arrival, Shen Qing walked over to Fang Heng.
"Fang Heng, did you have a good rest last night?"
"Yes."
"President Qin had an urgent business trip last night. Before she left, she said that you should temporarily stay in Team 3 until she comes back..."
Halfway through, Shen Qing's expression changed slightly. He shouted at a porter beside him, "Don't leave it there! Don't block the intersection! That's for people to pass through!"
The porter looked impatient. "Then where do you think we should leave it? Hurry up, there are still a lot of them down there!"
"Wait a minute!"
"I'm sorry, the new district, District 8, has opened. There's a big shift in Team 3 business department. I'm so busy with all these."

Shen Qing smiled apologetically and patted Fang Heng's shoulder warmly, "In short, that's the general situation. I'll go back to work first. There are still a lot of rookies reporting for duty today. Feel free to use the row of gaming cabins over there. If you run into any problem, come and find me."

After saying that, Shen Qing hurriedly ran to look for the workers to cause trouble. "What the hell? The power cord of the gaming cabins is exclusive. There will be a problem if you connect it like that!"
Uh...
Are they all so busy?
Fang Heng was helpless.

Indeed, the zombie apocalypse new district, District 8, had opened. The business department of the gaming company was now focused on District 9 and was channelling resources in it. It was only right for them to be a little busy.
Not only the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company but other gaming companies, clubs, player guilds and even the federal government would give their full support to the development of District 8.
Fang Heng felt the pressure of competing with these giants.
He needed to hurry up and build a shelter.
Fang Heng randomly found a game cabin and returned to the game.
[Hint: While you were offline, your zombie group carried barrels of gasoline*2, firewood*21, logs*291, abandoned parts*23... your skill - basic physical training experience points +8,912.]
[Hint: Your basic physical training level has been upgraded to Level 5.]
[Hint: Your skill - basic physical training level can not exceed the character's level. Please upgrade the player's level.]
In just one night, the basic physical training level had reached level 5?
The efficiency was amazing!
In the game, most players needed a long period of training to level up their skills.
Since zombie clones need not rest, they could log in 24 hours a day, and Fang Heng could greatly reduce the time needed to level up his skills.
"Normal weight-bearing travel can provide the skill level of basic physical training. Then, the upgrade of basic strength training and agility training will most likely depend on actual combat."
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
"Fang Heng, you rascal, what are you muttering so early in the morning?"
In the small cabin, Liao Bufan held a wooden board in one hand and gestured towards the cabin window.
"When Uncle Jimmy came online, he said that he had something to do today and will only return tonight. He even left seven crossbows for you."
"Liu Lin went out alone to explore the surrounding environment. I couldn't stop her, so I asked her to bring a crossbow with her."
