chapters.title: Chapter 29: Furnace
paragraphs: To save fuel, Fang Heng slowly returned to the prison on his bicycle.
Coincidentally, when he left, he saw two players walking towards the camp from afar.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu also saw Fang Heng at the same time.
Before Lu Yu could speak, Fang Heng had already turned away from another fork in the road.
The two of them looked at each other.
"That person just now seemed to be Fang Heng? The God?"
"It should be him."

Zhou Yi nodded and said, "Unfortunately, I've checked online. The God's character doesn't seem to be very good. I'm afraid that it would be troublesome to recruit him into the company. Otherwise, even if I had to spend a few million, I would still take him in..."
"What are you thinking about? A few million people might not be willing to come to your company."
"What's wrong? Is my company unpopular? Your bonus for next month is gone."
"The company has a bonus? How come I never got one?"
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu exchanged words, bickering to relieve the stress.
The two of them had worked hard for the whole day. They worked hard to complete a reconnaissance mission.
In the process, Zhou Yi was attacked by a zombie.
If it weren't for Lu Yu's quick wits, Zhou Yi would have lost his life.
Zhou Yi rubbed his face and said, "After completing this mission, we can buy earth-made bombs. It's a little late today. Tomorrow, we'll bomb the prison."
"After blowing up the barbed wire on the outside, it will take two or three days for the zombies inside to disperse. During this time, we'll collect more materials and reinforce the shelter."
Lu Yu nodded and became serious.
"By the way, how's the recruitment going?"
"We've interviewed a few professional players. They're all Level 5. We've signed a contract with them."
Zhou Yi was desperate to make a name for himself on this server and he didn't hesitate to invest a lot of money.
"However, after the new server is launched, they'll have to wait another week before they can come in. It won't be that fast."
The two of them chatted as they walked into the apocalypse merchant camp.
What... was going on?
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu stopped talking at the same time when they just stepped into the apocalypse merchant camp.
They stopped and looked at each other.
Inside the camp, there were messy piles of wooden planks to the left and the right.
A few NPC labour workers were busy moving them.
Where did these planks come from?!
When they came here to receive the mission earlier in the morning, there was clearly nothing there.
Lu Yu asked the apocalypse merchant about the situation.
"Vettel, why are there are so many wooden planks in the camp?"
"It was a survivor who helped me get them. That kid is really amazing."
Vettel was in a good mood today. As he checked the accounts and counted the materials, he answered with a smile.
"With these wooden planks, our camp's leveling plan will be on the agenda very soon."
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu were even more baffled.
A player!!
All these wooden planks were obtained by a player?!
Impossible!
It had only been a few days since the server opened!
Not to mention players, which guild had the ability to collect so many wooden planks in such a short time?
Perhaps only a bigshot like the federation government had the ability to do so.
While Zhou Yi was still in shock, Lu Yu instinctively thought of something.
He swallowed his saliva and asked the apocalypse merchant in a low voice.
"Vettel, the player you mentioned, is he called Fang Heng?"
Vettel put down the account book in his hand and raised his head to look at Lu Yu.
"Oh? You know him too?"
It was indeed Fang Heng!
A terrifying God!
The sky gradually darkened.
Liao Bufan and the others cleaned up the entire first floor of Building No. 3 during the day. They even specially arranged a relatively clean room for everyone to rest in.
Old man Jimmy seemed to have something on today and logged off early.
"Finally, we don't have to worry anymore."
Liao Bufan gulped down a mouthful of beer, stretched his back and stuffed a piece of roasted meat into his mouth.
The taste.
It was amazing!
Liu Lin was in a corner by the window.
She was fiddling with the two furnaces that Fang Heng had just exchanged for today, adding firewood and iron waste into them.
The furnaces could melt iron ore and iron waste by burning firewood to make iron nuggets.
Iron nuggets were the basis of advanced materials in the zombie apocalypse game.
For example, nails, which were in short supply when making shelters.
At this moment, Liu Lin deeply felt the power of Fang Heng's talent skill.
How many days had it been?
In the previous server, Server No. 7, she remembered that the fastest guild had spent half a month to complete the basic production of iron nuggets.
As for Fang Heng...
It had only been less than a week and he had already started preparing to mass-produce iron nuggets!
Thinking about it, it really felt like a dream.
Initially, after learning that she had been forcefully pulled into a new server, Liu Lin was still very nervous.
However, things had reached this point and everything was progressing exceptionally well.
As long as they did not encounter hostile players, the prison could provide them with sufficient security.
A small number of zombies could not break into the outermost layer of the barbed wire fence even after scratching the gate for an entire night.
The new server's zombie apocalypse that everyone was fearful about seemed to have become exceptionally simple.
Liu Lin's gaze unconsciously turned to Fang Heng.
He was the one who made all these changes.
Fang Heng ate something and started reading the game log.
At night, he arranged for the zombies to go to the surrounding area of the prison to cut down the trees.
They would only cut down the trees, not move them.
He felt that the zombies were too slow, especially when they were carrying heavy loads.
In order to increase efficiency, Fang Heng asked the zombies to cut down the trees and asked Liao Bufan to help collect the logs the next day.
Even if some players passed by during the day and picked up logs, how much could they collect?
Fang Heng was planning his operation for the next day when Liao Bufan coughed to attract everyone's attention.
"By the way, Big Brother, now that we have nails and logs, we have enough resources for the shelter. Where are you going to build the shelter?"
The game provided hundreds of blueprints for the simulated construction of shelters.
Players could use the blueprints to build shelters, modify them, or even reconstruct them.
Each blueprint required different materials.
The larger the shelter, the more materials would be consumed.
Fang Heng was already prepared for Liao Bufan's question.
"We will build it in the basement."
In the game, digging three feet underground was the safest.
Zombies didn't know how to dig underground.
Of course, if it really reached the later stage, when the shelter's defence was strong enough, it would slowly extend to the ground.
Fang Heng's current architectural layout was to rely on the prison outside to build the shelter.
In fact, the building outside the prison was already part of the extension of the shelter, but it was not recognized by the game system.
However, the core, as well as the most important part, was to be built in the basement.
This was for safety.
"Eh, but there are... spider zombies in the basement."
Liao Bufan shrunk his neck.
He had heard Fang Heng talk about it.
The dangerous group in the basement.
There were many spider zombies in there.
Ordinary players were no match for them at all.
Just hearing that there were many spider zombies, Liao Bufan felt a chill down his spine.
"I've already thought about this."
When the flamethrower arrived tomorrow afternoon, he could try to break into the basement.
Fang Heng suddenly thought of the mission in the police diary.
The hidden mission had just entered the second phase and he had to deal with a difficult group of spider zombies.
The difficulty level was a little too high.
This meant that the reward must be good.
For example, he was rewarded with a pistol in the first phase.
Not to mention the possibility of evolution crystals being dropped after killing the spider zombies!
While thinking, Fang Heng looked at Liao Bufan.
"The roast meat tastes good, right?"
Liao Bufan nodded.
It was hard for him to deny this.
"Then come and help tomorrow afternoon. We'll go to the basement together and deal with the zombies."
"No way! Big Brother, are you serious?"

sentences.text: To save fuel, Fang Heng slowly returned to the prison on his bicycle.
Coincidentally, when he left, he saw two players walking towards the camp from afar.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu also saw Fang Heng at the same time.
Before Lu Yu could speak, Fang Heng had already turned away from another fork in the road.
The two of them looked at each other.
"That person just now seemed to be Fang Heng?
The God?"
"It should be him."
Zhou Yi nodded and said, "Unfortunately, I've checked online.
The God's character doesn't seem to be very good.
I'm afraid that it would be troublesome to recruit him into the company.
Otherwise, even if I had to spend a few million, I would still take him in..."
"What are you thinking about?
A few million people might not be willing to come to your company."
"What's wrong?
Is my company unpopular?
Your bonus for next month is gone."
"The company has a bonus?
How come I never got one?"
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu exchanged words, bickering to relieve the stress.
The two of them had worked hard for the whole day.
They worked hard to complete a reconnaissance mission.
In the process, Zhou Yi was attacked by a zombie.
If it weren't for Lu Yu's quick wits, Zhou Yi would have lost his life.
Zhou Yi rubbed his face and said, "After completing this mission, we can buy earth-made bombs.
It's a little late today.
Tomorrow, we'll bomb the prison."
"After blowing up the barbed wire on the outside, it will take two or three days for the zombies inside to disperse.
During this time, we'll collect more materials and reinforce the shelter."
Lu Yu nodded and became serious.
"By the way, how's the recruitment going?"
"We've interviewed a few professional players.
They're all Level 5.
We've signed a contract with them."
Zhou Yi was desperate to make a name for himself on this server and he didn't hesitate to invest a lot of money.
"However, after the new server is launched, they'll have to wait another week before they can come in.
It won't be that fast."
The two of them chatted as they walked into the apocalypse merchant camp.
What... was going on?
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu stopped talking at the same time when they just stepped into the apocalypse merchant camp.
They stopped and looked at each other.
Inside the camp, there were messy piles of wooden planks to the left and the right.
A few NPC labour workers were busy moving them.
Where did these planks come from?!
When they came here to receive the mission earlier in the morning, there was clearly nothing there.
Lu Yu asked the apocalypse merchant about the situation.
"Vettel, why are there are so many wooden planks in the camp?"
"It was a survivor who helped me get them.
That kid is really amazing."
Vettel was in a good mood today.
As he checked the accounts and counted the materials, he answered with a smile.
"With these wooden planks, our camp's leveling plan will be on the agenda very soon."
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu were even more baffled.
A player!!
All these wooden planks were obtained by a player?!
Impossible!
It had only been a few days since the server opened!
Not to mention players, which guild had the ability to collect so many wooden planks in such a short time?
Perhaps only a bigshot like the federation government had the ability to do so.
While Zhou Yi was still in shock, Lu Yu instinctively thought of something.
He swallowed his saliva and asked the apocalypse merchant in a low voice.
"Vettel, the player you mentioned, is he called Fang Heng?"
Vettel put down the account book in his hand and raised his head to look at Lu Yu.
"Oh?
You know him too?"
It was indeed Fang Heng!
A terrifying God!
The sky gradually darkened.
Liao Bufan and the others cleaned up the entire first floor of Building No.
3 during the day.
They even specially arranged a relatively clean room for everyone to rest in.
Old man Jimmy seemed to have something on today and logged off early.
"Finally, we don't have to worry anymore."
Liao Bufan gulped down a mouthful of beer, stretched his back and stuffed a piece of roasted meat into his mouth.
The taste.
It was amazing!
Liu Lin was in a corner by the window.
She was fiddling with the two furnaces that Fang Heng had just exchanged for today, adding firewood and iron waste into them.
The furnaces could melt iron ore and iron waste by burning firewood to make iron nuggets.
Iron nuggets were the basis of advanced materials in the zombie apocalypse game.
For example, nails, which were in short supply when making shelters.
At this moment, Liu Lin deeply felt the power of Fang Heng's talent skill.
How many days had it been?
In the previous server, Server No.
7, she remembered that the fastest guild had spent half a month to complete the basic production of iron nuggets.
As for Fang Heng...
It had only been less than a week and he had already started preparing to mass-produce iron nuggets!
Thinking about it, it really felt like a dream.
Initially, after learning that she had been forcefully pulled into a new server, Liu Lin was still very nervous.
However, things had reached this point and everything was progressing exceptionally well.
As long as they did not encounter hostile players, the prison could provide them with sufficient security.
A small number of zombies could not break into the outermost layer of the barbed wire fence even after scratching the gate for an entire night.
The new server's zombie apocalypse that everyone was fearful about seemed to have become exceptionally simple.
Liu Lin's gaze unconsciously turned to Fang Heng.
He was the one who made all these changes.
Fang Heng ate something and started reading the game log.
At night, he arranged for the zombies to go to the surrounding area of the prison to cut down the trees.
They would only cut down the trees, not move them.
He felt that the zombies were too slow, especially when they were carrying heavy loads.
In order to increase efficiency, Fang Heng asked the zombies to cut down the trees and asked Liao Bufan to help collect the logs the next day.
Even if some players passed by during the day and picked up logs, how much could they collect?
Fang Heng was planning his operation for the next day when Liao Bufan coughed to attract everyone's attention.
"By the way, Big Brother, now that we have nails and logs, we have enough resources for the shelter.
Where are you going to build the shelter?"
The game provided hundreds of blueprints for the simulated construction of shelters.
Players could use the blueprints to build shelters, modify them, or even reconstruct them.
Each blueprint required different materials.
The larger the shelter, the more materials would be consumed.
Fang Heng was already prepared for Liao Bufan's question.
"We will build it in the basement."
In the game, digging three feet underground was the safest.
Zombies didn't know how to dig underground.
Of course, if it really reached the later stage, when the shelter's defence was strong enough, it would slowly extend to the ground.
Fang Heng's current architectural layout was to rely on the prison outside to build the shelter.
In fact, the building outside the prison was already part of the extension of the shelter, but it was not recognized by the game system.
However, the core, as well as the most important part, was to be built in the basement.
This was for safety.
"Eh, but there are... spider zombies in the basement."
Liao Bufan shrunk his neck.
He had heard Fang Heng talk about it.
The dangerous group in the basement.
There were many spider zombies in there.
Ordinary players were no match for them at all.
Just hearing that there were many spider zombies, Liao Bufan felt a chill down his spine.
"I've already thought about this."
When the flamethrower arrived tomorrow afternoon, he could try to break into the basement.
Fang Heng suddenly thought of the mission in the police diary.
The hidden mission had just entered the second phase and he had to deal with a difficult group of spider zombies.
The difficulty level was a little too high.
This meant that the reward must be good.
For example, he was rewarded with a pistol in the first phase.
Not to mention the possibility of evolution crystals being dropped after killing the spider zombies!
While thinking, Fang Heng looked at Liao Bufan.
"The roast meat tastes good, right?"
Liao Bufan nodded.
It was hard for him to deny this.
"Then come and help tomorrow afternoon.
We'll go to the basement together and deal with the zombies."
"No way!
Big Brother, are you serious?"

chapters.title: Chapter 30: The Upper Limit
paragraphs: "Fang Heng, I'm so lucky to have met you."
In the apocalypse merchant camp, Vettel was grinning from ear to ear.
"But Fang Heng, we don't lack wooden planks anymore. You can go to the other apocalypse camps and take a look. They still lack a lot of wooden planks."
No more?
They have already reached the upper limit?
A hint of disappointment flashed across Fang Heng's face.
He opened the mission panel to confirm.
The mission for collecting wooden planks (repeatable) for the apocalypse merchant camp had disappeared from the mission panel
What a pity.
He had originally wanted to empty the apocalypse merchant camp.
He didn't expect the King of Gods to set a limit.
Vettel continued, "I've mentioned you to the other apocalypse merchants. They will definitely welcome your arrival."
"This is my personal map. The locations of their camps are marked on it. This would be helpful to you."
[Hint: Your friendship with Vettel has become stronger.]
[Hint: Vettel has given you a map. You can use the map to navigate the location of the seven apocalypse merchant camps.]
"Thank you."
Fang Heng took the map and looked at it.
The seven apocalypse merchant camps marked on the map were all quite far away from here.
Even the closest one was more than 200 kilometers away.
His shelter hadn't been completed yet, so he couldn't leave.
It wasn't practical to go there just to provide the wood.
"I also have good news for you. Your goods have arrived. Come with me. Hehe, I promise, this is good stuff for dealing with zombies."
Merchant Vettel brought Fang Heng into the cabin.
He took out a wooden box from under the cabinet and put it on the cabinet with a bang.
"Look, this is the treasure."
Fang Heng opened the wooden box, and inside was a bright red focus flamethrower.
The focused flamethrower was shaped like a large submachine gun.
The difference was that the front end of the muzzle looked like a water pipe, and the mouth of the pipe was big and thick.
Fang Heng tried to lift it.
It was very heavy and needed to be placed on the shoulder to be used.
[Hint: You have obtained an item-focused flamethrower M-021*1.]
"The zombies would lose consciousness, but most of them are instinctively afraid of fire. This flamethrower is absolutely useful."
Vetter bragged and placed a few blue wooden boxes on the counter.
"Also, this is the fuel for your equipment. Be careful, they are explosive and very heavy."
The fuel bottle was a mixture of special gases. After high-pressure sealing, it was very heavy.
Vettel finally handed a booklet to Fang Heng.
"Finally, this is the complimentary instruction manual. Use It carefully to ensure safety."
Fang Heng took the booklet.
According to the description in the instruction manual, the correct use of the focused flamethrower required the coordination of two people at the same time.
One controlled the lance of the focus flamethrower and the other controlled the intensity of the flame by lifting the heavy fuel bottle.
The zombie's movements were too rigid to coordinate accurately.
He'll have to find another toolman to help.
There's also the issue of cooling time.
He mentally went through the plan to clear the basement.
The focused flamethrower would overheat after a period of use.
Once the temperature reached 50%, the durability of the flamethrower would be depleted at a fast rate, so it was necessary to keep the temperature below 50% for safe use.
In addition, there was fuel.
Even with experience, it would take at least three minutes to change the fuel at a time.
If there were a large number of spider zombies in the passage, the flamethrower alone might not be able to stop them.
They didn't have time to change the fuel.
What should they do?
Got it!
Fang Heng raised his head.
"Vettel, please give me another twenty barrels of gasoline."
"No problem, here are the twenty barrels of gasoline you asked for."
[Hint: You have obtained focused flamethrower fuel bottle*20, gasoline*20.]
At the prison, the entrance to the basement.
Liao Bufan was a little flustered.
He carefully observed his surroundings and lowered his voice.
"Fang Heng, are we really going in? Why don't we just forget about it this time? We can just withdraw, right? We don't need to put ourselves at risk, our lives are more important."
"Don't panic, I have a plan."
Fang Heng replied softly. He used the key to open the first two iron doors, leaving only the last one.
Then, he pressed his ear against the door.
"Good, there's no sound inside." he thought to himself.
The spider zombies didn't block the door.
Fang Heng took out a focused flamethrower from his backpack.
"What the hell? A flamethrower!"
Liao Bufan was stunned when he saw Fang Heng take out such a powerful weapon from his backpack.
"I'm so envious!"
Liao Bufan felt tempted. He reached out his hand to touch the flamethrower, feeling very excited.
"This is a treasure! Big Brother, where did you get it?
He had been worried for a long time. It turned out that Fang Heng was prepared.
With such a powerful weapon, what was there to be afraid of?
Liao Bufan was secretly upset that Fang Heng didn't tell him earlier, causing him to be on tenterhooks for a long time.
"It's a secret. Come, give me a hand."
Fang Heng tried to connect the fuel bottle to the flamethrower and placed the fuel bottle on the ground.
"It's coming."
Liao Bufan helped carry the fuel bottle behind Fang Heng and adjusted the flame setting raft.
Fang Heng controlled the switch and direction of the flamethrower.
Everything was ready.
"Three, two, one..."
Fang Heng signalled with his fingers and carefully pushed open the last iron door of the basement.
"Crack..."
Inside the iron door, a straight passageway about 30 meters came into view.
There was nothing inside the passageway and at the end, there was a corner to the right.
After the corner was an invisible blind spot.
The two of them exchanged a glance.
Liao Bufan turned his head to look at Fang Heng.
"What should we do?"
"Shh."
Fang Heng raised his hand to signal Liao Bufan to keep quiet.
He waved his hand.
The five zombie clones following the two of them walked into the passageway.
They staggered forward until they reached the end of the straight passageway.
The zombie clones stopped, then slowly took out wooden frames from their backpacks and put them on the ground.
"Wooden frames? What are they trying to do?"
Looking at the zombies, Liao Bufan murmured in a low voice, his eyes filled with confusion.
After five minutes, the zombies piled fifty to sixty wooden frames at the corner, blocking almost half of the passageway.
After the wooden frames were piled up, the zombies took out a bottle of gasoline, opened the lid and poured it on the wooden frames.
In the end, the zombie clones slowly poured the remaining gasoline along the passageway towards where Fang Heng was standing.
Liao Bufan felt that he understood something, but he didn't seem to understand it completely.
He looked at Fang Heng and asked in a low voice.
"Will there be a problem? Do you want to burn this place down?"
"Of course, it's not a problem. Uncle Jimmy has checked the structure of this place. It's all bare steel and concrete. It won't burn down the place."
"That's good."
Liao Bufan heaved a sigh of relief.
It wasn't easy to build a shelter. It would be a pity if it was accidentally burned down.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Burning Spiders
paragraphs: Fang Heng temporarily placed the flamethrower on the ground and asked, "Are you ready?"
Liao Bufan gave Fang Heng a thumbs-up.
"Yes!"
Fang Heng controlled the zombie clones to leave the underground passageway.
He carefully walked five steps into the passageway and took out a small stone from his backpack.
"Sshhh!"
Fang Heng threw the stone toward the end of the passageway.
"Pa! Dadadada..."
The stone hit the ground and made a series of sounds.
One second, two seconds...
"Crack...crack..."
Three seconds later, the sound of something rubbing against the wall came from inside the passageway.
Fang Heng turned around and ran.
He grabbed the flamethrower on the ground and placed it on his shoulder. He turned around and aimed the flamethrower at the front of the passageway.
"Crack! Crack! Crack!"
The sound approached in an instant.
A drop of cold sweat dripped down Liao Bufan's face as he stared at the entrance of the passageway.
"D*mn it! How did this create such a big commotion? How many spider zombies are there in this passageway?" he thought nervously to himself.
Liao Bufan's heart couldn't help but beat faster.
The first spider zombie came around the corner and appeared in their sight.
It climbed directly towards the two of them from the side along the left wall.
It was extremely fast!
It was covering a distance of thirty meters within a short period!
Liao Bufan's face was pale as he shouted.
"Fang Heng!"
Fang Heng didn't move.
His eyes were fixed on the corner.
Over there, zombie spiders were crazily climbing out of the four walls.
There were too many of them, and they were too fast.
They even knocked away many wooden frames blocking the passageway!
Just wait a bit more!
Fang Heng pressed his index finger on the trigger.
He could hear his own heartbeat.
He wanted to kill as many spider zombies as possible!
A large number of spider zombies rushed out from the corner.
The first spider zombie that rushed out from the corner had already picked up the smell of human flesh.
Its twisted limbs exerted a force on the wall and its whole body rose abruptly from the ground.
"Psst!"
The spider zombie flew up and was ready to pounce on Fang Heng.
Liao Bufan exclaimed.
"Fang Heng! Hurry!"
The spider zombie was about to move its claws.
Fang Heng steadily held the flamethrower and pressed the trigger with his index finger.
"Boom!! "
The flamethrower roared.
A long strip of pale blue high-temperature flame was spat out from the mouth of the flamethrower.
The spider zombie that was charging straight at the mouth of the flamethrower was hit directly by the flame!
"Squeak!!!"
The spider zombie let out a strange cry. Its entire body was instantly ignited and burned intensely. Its entire body was sent flying backward.
"Pa!"
The zombie fell to the ground.
Its body kept twisting and struggling on the ground. The flame on its body could not be extinguished and it kept squeaking miserably.
It wasn't completely dead after being burned by the flamethrower!
The mutated zombies were really troublesome!
Fang Heng secretly clenched his teeth.
He had no time to care about how much damage the burning had done.
More spider zombies skimmed over the burning spider zombie which was rolling on the ground.
They rushed toward Fang Heng one after another.
"Fang Heng! There are too many!"
Liao Bufan's forehead was full of sweat. He immediately turned the fire valve to its maximum power.
Fang Heng heard him.
He didn't have the time to answer. He gritted his teeth and controlled the flames to drive off the spider zombies.
"Squeak! Squeak!"

The spider zombies that came after him weren't afraid of death. They jumped into the sea of fire one by one and were burned by the high temperature of the flames. Their bodies were on fire and they rolled backwards.
"Fang Heng!"
Seeing that more and more spider zombies were coming, Liao Bufan shouted out his name.
"It's not good. Prepare to retreat. There are too many of them! Half of the fuel has been consumed!"
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
"Retreat, over my dead body!" Fang Heng thought to himself.
The word "retreat" was not in this plan at all!
The flamethrower's output was strong, the firepower was fierce and it was exhilarating using it.
But how could the fuel be consumed so quickly?
In the video Fang Heng saw in his memory, that player used the focused flamethrower to burn for nearly half an hour before he ran out of a can of fuel.
How long had it been?
Could it be that the product Vettel sold him was inferior?
"How can it be used so quickly?"
"How can it be so fast?"
Liao Bufan was burning with anxiety. He shouted, "We've always adjusted the maximum power! Otherwise, we wouldn't have been able to hold on for long!"
"Got it!"
Fang Heng quickly understood.
In the video that he saw in his memory, the player was dealing with almost all ordinary zombies. Only one or two mutated zombies would appear occasionally.
There was no need to use the maximum power to deal with such a situation.
As for him, he was dealing with all spider zombies!
Fang Heng wanted to farm for a while more.
There was no other way. He was running out of fuel.
Fang Heng had no choice but to tilt the flame nozzle and aim at the gasoline on the other side of the ground.
"Boom!"
The gasoline on the ground was ignited.
The flame quickly moved forward along the gasoline.
The wooden frames that blocked the corner at the end of the passageway were also ignited in an instant and started to burn fiercely.
The burning wooden frames had formed a wall of fire in a short period of time!
The spider zombies were very afraid of fire.
The burning corner of the passageway had cut off the spider zombies that were coming.
Seeing that, Liao Bufan's eyes lit up.
He understood!
"So that's how those wooden frames are used!"
"It's f*cking awesome!"
"It turns out that everything was part of the boss' plan."
The corner of Liao Bufan's mouth curled up and his tensed mind relaxed a little.
"F*ck, I was worried for nothing again!"
Without the continuous stream of spider zombies joining the battlefield, the pressure on Fang Heng and Liao Bufan was greatly reduced!
Now, they only needed to get rid of the remaining spider zombies that were not completely dead.
The flamethrower had reached a dangerous temperature of 91%.
Fang Heng had no choice but to temporarily close the valve on hand.
If he continued forcefully, the durability and even the upper limit of the flamethrower would be greatly reduced.
The flames stopped for a while.
Liao Bufan vigilantly looked at the spider zombies in front of him.
The squeaking sounds of the spider zombies were everywhere and the air was filled with the smell of rotting and burnt flesh.
It was like hell.
Some of the zombies were writhing on the ground, while others were trying to escape. They tried to run back, but were stopped by the wall of fire behind them.
The remaining ones were the most troublesome ones. Even though their bodies were burning with flames, they were still rushing toward Fang Heng.
"Boom!!!"
Less than half a minute later, the flamethrower's nozzle was still at 89% critical temperature. Fang Heng had no choice but to press the switch again.
"Fang Heng, there's still a quarter of the fuel left!"
Liao Bufan said as he quickly reduced the flame efficiency slightly.
Fang Heng frowned.
Mutated zombies were troublesome!
Even the spider zombies with low HP and low fire resistance were still so difficult to deal with.
Even with his flamethrower, they were not able to defeat most of the spider zombies!
Leveling up was really too difficult!
Fang Heng was glad that he had planned and used the artificial firewall to block the entrance to the rear passageway.

sentences.text: Fang Heng temporarily placed the flamethrower on the ground and asked, "Are you ready?"
Liao Bufan gave Fang Heng a thumbs-up.
"Yes!"
Fang Heng controlled the zombie clones to leave the underground passageway.
He carefully walked five steps into the passageway and took out a small stone from his backpack.
"Sshhh!"
Fang Heng threw the stone toward the end of the passageway.
"Pa!
Dadadada..."
The stone hit the ground and made a series of sounds.
One second, two seconds...
"Crack...crack..."
Three seconds later, the sound of something rubbing against the wall came from inside the passageway.
Fang Heng turned around and ran.
He grabbed the flamethrower on the ground and placed it on his shoulder.
He turned around and aimed the flamethrower at the front of the passageway.
"Crack!
Crack!
Crack!"
The sound approached in an instant.
A drop of cold sweat dripped down Liao Bufan's face as he stared at the entrance of the passageway.
"D*mn it!
How did this create such a big commotion?
How many spider zombies are there in this passageway?" he thought nervously to himself.
Liao Bufan's heart couldn't help but beat faster.
The first spider zombie came around the corner and appeared in their sight.
It climbed directly towards the two of them from the side along the left wall.
It was extremely fast!
It was covering a distance of thirty meters within a short period!
Liao Bufan's face was pale as he shouted.
"Fang Heng!"
Fang Heng didn't move.
His eyes were fixed on the corner.
Over there, zombie spiders were crazily climbing out of the four walls.
There were too many of them, and they were too fast.
They even knocked away many wooden frames blocking the passageway!
Just wait a bit more!
Fang Heng pressed his index finger on the trigger.
He could hear his own heartbeat.
He wanted to kill as many spider zombies as possible!
A large number of spider zombies rushed out from the corner.
The first spider zombie that rushed out from the corner had already picked up the smell of human flesh.
Its twisted limbs exerted a force on the wall and its whole body rose abruptly from the ground.
"Psst!"
The spider zombie flew up and was ready to pounce on Fang Heng.
Liao Bufan exclaimed.
"Fang Heng!
Hurry!"
The spider zombie was about to move its claws.
Fang Heng steadily held the flamethrower and pressed the trigger with his index finger.
"Boom!!
The flamethrower roared.
A long strip of pale blue high-temperature flame was spat out from the mouth of the flamethrower.
The spider zombie that was charging straight at the mouth of the flamethrower was hit directly by the flame!
"Squeak!!!"
The spider zombie let out a strange cry.
Its entire body was instantly ignited and burned intensely.
Its entire body was sent flying backward.
"Pa!"
The zombie fell to the ground.
Its body kept twisting and struggling on the ground.
The flame on its body could not be extinguished and it kept squeaking miserably.
It wasn't completely dead after being burned by the flamethrower!
The mutated zombies were really troublesome!
Fang Heng secretly clenched his teeth.
He had no time to care about how much damage the burning had done.
More spider zombies skimmed over the burning spider zombie which was rolling on the ground.
They rushed toward Fang Heng one after another.
"Fang Heng!
There are too many!"
Liao Bufan's forehead was full of sweat.
He immediately turned the fire valve to its maximum power.
Fang Heng heard him.
He didn't have the time to answer.
He gritted his teeth and controlled the flames to drive off the spider zombies.
"Squeak!
Squeak!"
The spider zombies that came after him weren't afraid of death.
They jumped into the sea of fire one by one and were burned by the high temperature of the flames.
Their bodies were on fire and they rolled backwards.
"Fang Heng!"
Seeing that more and more spider zombies were coming, Liao Bufan shouted out his name.
"It's not good.
Prepare to retreat.
There are too many of them!
Half of the fuel has been consumed!"
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
"Retreat, over my dead body!" Fang Heng thought to himself.
The word "retreat" was not in this plan at all!
The flamethrower's output was strong, the firepower was fierce and it was exhilarating using it.
But how could the fuel be consumed so quickly?
In the video Fang Heng saw in his memory, that player used the focused flamethrower to burn for nearly half an hour before he ran out of a can of fuel.
How long had it been?
Could it be that the product Vettel sold him was inferior?
"How can it be used so quickly?"
"How can it be so fast?"
Liao Bufan was burning with anxiety.
He shouted, "We've always adjusted the maximum power!
Otherwise, we wouldn't have been able to hold on for long!"
"Got it!"
Fang Heng quickly understood.
In the video that he saw in his memory, the player was dealing with almost all ordinary zombies.
Only one or two mutated zombies would appear occasionally.
There was no need to use the maximum power to deal with such a situation.
As for him, he was dealing with all spider zombies!
Fang Heng wanted to farm for a while more.
There was no other way.
He was running out of fuel.
Fang Heng had no choice but to tilt the flame nozzle and aim at the gasoline on the other side of the ground.
"Boom!"
The gasoline on the ground was ignited.
The flame quickly moved forward along the gasoline.
The wooden frames that blocked the corner at the end of the passageway were also ignited in an instant and started to burn fiercely.
The burning wooden frames had formed a wall of fire in a short period of time!
The spider zombies were very afraid of fire.
The burning corner of the passageway had cut off the spider zombies that were coming.
Seeing that, Liao Bufan's eyes lit up.
He understood!
"So that's how those wooden frames are used!"
"It's f*cking awesome!"
"It turns out that everything was part of the boss' plan."
The corner of Liao Bufan's mouth curled up and his tensed mind relaxed a little.
"F*ck, I was worried for nothing again!"
Without the continuous stream of spider zombies joining the battlefield, the pressure on Fang Heng and Liao Bufan was greatly reduced!
Now, they only needed to get rid of the remaining spider zombies that were not completely dead.
The flamethrower had reached a dangerous temperature of 91%.
Fang Heng had no choice but to temporarily close the valve on hand.
If he continued forcefully, the durability and even the upper limit of the flamethrower would be greatly reduced.
The flames stopped for a while.
Liao Bufan vigilantly looked at the spider zombies in front of him.
The squeaking sounds of the spider zombies were everywhere and the air was filled with the smell of rotting and burnt flesh.
It was like hell.
Some of the zombies were writhing on the ground, while others were trying to escape.
They tried to run back, but were stopped by the wall of fire behind them.
The remaining ones were the most troublesome ones.
Even though their bodies were burning with flames, they were still rushing toward Fang Heng.
"Boom!!!"
Less than half a minute later, the flamethrower's nozzle was still at 89% critical temperature.
Fang Heng had no choice but to press the switch again.
"Fang Heng, there's still a quarter of the fuel left!"
Liao Bufan said as he quickly reduced the flame efficiency slightly.
Fang Heng frowned.
Mutated zombies were troublesome!
Even the spider zombies with low HP and low fire resistance were still so difficult to deal with.
Even with his flamethrower, they were not able to defeat most of the spider zombies!
Leveling up was really too difficult!
Fang Heng was glad that he had planned and used the artificial firewall to block the entrance to the rear passageway.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: The Team Grew Stronger
paragraphs: Soon, the number of spider zombies began to decrease significantly.
The pressure on Fang Heng and Liao Bufan also gradually lessened.
"Liao Bufan, how much fuel do we have left?"
Liao Bufan reached out his hand to wipe away the large beads of sweat that were dripping down his forehead.
Fang Heng nodded.
That was enough.
Three-quarters of this group of spider zombies had died, so they were no longer a threat.
While Fang Heng was controlling the switch of the flamethrower, he was also taking a peek at the game log.
The game log had already been refreshed.
[Hint: Player has successfully killed the spider zombie. Player has obtained 23 survival points.]
[Hint: Player has successfully killed the spider zombie. Player has obtained 33 survival points.]
[Hint: Player has obtained a complete evolution crystal*1.]
[Hint: Player has successfully killed the spider zombie. Player has obtained 33 survival points.] ...
Among the mutated zombies, spider zombies were considered to be the higher-level type.
Therefore, the probability of them dropping complete evolution crystals was higher.
Fang Heng took a quick glance and saw that there were at least five or six of them.
It was enough for him to level up to Level 7!
Five minutes later, the last spider zombie completely lost its breath under the burning flames.
Coincidentally, the tank of fuel was used up.
The entire passageway was filled with charred corpses.
Under the corpses, there were still red specks on the ground, emitting a bloody glow.
These were the evolution crystals that the spider zombies had dropped after they died.
Fang Heng stretched out his hand.
"Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!"
The evolution crystals that were left on the ground flew into Fang Heng's hand one by one.
[Hint: You have obtained the complete evolution crystal*15.]
Fang Heng turned his head to look at Liao Bufan.
"Let's go out first."
While the wooden frames at the entrance of the passage were still burning and the flame barrier still had a protective effect, Fang Heng and Liao Bufan quickly exited the passageway.
Outside the passageway.
Fang Heng locked the three iron doors tightly.
Liao Bufan's short sleeve was already soaked completely in sweat.
He had been under tremendous psychological pressure during the battle just now.
Not to mention that the high temperature caused by the flames made the entire basement as unbearable as a furnace.
It was so hot!
Liao Bufan and Fang Heng looked as if they had just been lifted from the waters.
Liao Bufan leaned against the wall and sat down limply.
He felt that he had just visited the gates of Hell not long ago.
Fortunately, he was lucky.
"Sigh!
Liao Bufan let out a long sigh.
He seemed to be moved by something.
"Boss, you owe me a pay rise!"
After Fang Heng locked the three doors firmly, he sat down beside Liao Bufan.
At this time, he could finally relax and rest.
"You have a point."
Fang Heng said as he took out the evolution crystal fragments from his backpack. He opened his palm and handed them to Liao Bufan.
"Is this enough?"
"Crystal fragments? So many?"
Liao Bufan's eyes lit up when he saw these shiny evolution crystal fragments.
"Enough, enough, boss is generous!"
Liao Bufan, who was originally dejected, immediately put on a smiling face.
He grabbed the evolution crystal fragments from Fang Heng and crushed them in his hand.
Liao Bufan had reached Level 4.
Fang Heng sat on the ground and started to read the game log. He counted the profits from cleaning the prison's basement.
He killed 57 spider zombies and obtained 17 complete evolution crystals.
"Not bad!"
Fang Heng held the evolution crystals in his hand.
"Bang!"
A thick red aura burst out from his palm and merged into his body.
"Bang! Bang!"
For a moment, the pathway was filled with the sound of crystals shattering.
Liao Bufan was watching Fang Heng absorb the power of the evolution crystals with envy.
"Look at him! He's starting to level up! With this stance, he was probably about to reach Level 10, right?"
Even though he was envious, Liao Bufan was still very satisfied.
After all, Fang Heng was an exception. Why would he compare himself with him?
Liao Bufan thought to himself that he had already reached Level 4.
At this stage of the game, how many players could reach Level 4?
He was also a top player!
If he hadn't met Fang Heng, he might still be gnawing on tree roots somewhere.
Liao Bufan thought happily. He took out two cans of beer from his backpack, handed one to Fang Heng and started to drink from his can.
[Hint: Your character level has been upgraded to Level 7.]
[Hint: Due to the enhancement of your talent skill-splitting zombie clone, you have gained an additional zombie clone*7.]
After absorbing the power of the evolution crystals, Fang Heng's level was successfully upgraded to Level 7. He was about a quarter away from Level 8.
The cement floor beside Fang Heng's feet began to twist.
A red magic array emerged from the ground.
"Chi!"
A greenish-gray arm suddenly reached out from the magic array.
The zombie clones came out from the magic array one by one and stood behind Fang Heng.
There were seven of them in total.
A moment later, the magic array disappeared.
Fang Heng waved his hand and told the zombies to run outside to collect materials.
He would be able to reach Level 8 soon by gaining the remaining quarter of experience points.
If he was lucky enough, he might be able to reach Level 9 today if there were enough spider zombies in the passageway!
Thinking of that, Fang Heng suddenly felt energized.
"Have you rested enough? Are you ready to start the next wave?"
"No way! Boss? I haven't rested enough yet!"
Liao Bufan took out another can of beer and looked at Fang Heng eagerly.
"Why don't we rest a little longer?"
The next day at noon.
In the basement passageway.
Fang Heng waved his hand and attracted the evolution crystals on the ground to his palm.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The evolution crystals exploded one after another.
The scarlet mist was instantly absorbed by Fang Heng.
[Hint: Your character level has been upgraded to Level 9.]
[Hint: Due to the enhancement of your talent skill-splitting zombie clone, you have gained an additional zombie clone*9.]
Now, after his character level had been upgraded to Level 9, Fang Heng had a total of 45 zombie clones.
Compared to the past two days, his overall strength had almost doubled.
The efficiency of gathering materials had also doubled.
"Whew! The last batch of spiders is finally gone!"
Liao Bufan let out a sigh of relief with his bare arms.
He sat on the ground with a sense of relief.
Beside him were more than ten empty fuel tanks.
Half an hour had passed and no more spider zombies were emerging from the right corner of the corridor.
Including yesterday afternoon and this morning, Fang Heng and Liao Bufan had scrubbed the basement passageway five to six times.
"Let's go in and take a look."
After a short rest, they loaded new fuel bottles and continued to explore.
Fang Heng held the flamethrower and walked in front.
He carefully walked around the corner and took a few more steps forward.
A fork appeared in front of him.
The fork was divided into a straight path forward and another path to the left.
The straight path ahead was cut off by three lowered iron gates.
Through the gap between the iron railings, Fang Heng looked inside.
Behind the three iron gates seemed to be a staircase leading down.
It seemed that there was a deeper passageway below.
"Why is the basement of this prison so deep?"
Liao Bufan also noticed the staircase and could not help but twitch his lips.
Fang Heng, on the other hand, frowned and whispered, "That's strange."

chapters.title: Chapter 33: The Second Basement
paragraphs: "What's wrong?"
Fang Heng took out the map of the prison that he had found on the first floor from his backpack and compared it with the terrain of the scene.
"Look, our position on the map is here. This is the marked warehouse. There's no problem here. It's just on our right."
"There's no problem here either. The passageway that turns left in front is connected to the basement of Building No. 2."
Liao Bufan leaned over to take a look.
It was just as Fang Heng said.
He soon discovered the problem.
"Huh? The passageway in front of us isn't marked on the map?"
"Yes, and the map doesn't indicate that there's a second basement in the prison."
Fang Heng checked the map repeatedly to confirm.
He then used his hand to pry the railings of the iron gate to check.
The iron gate was unusually heavy and strong.
On the wall of the iron gate, there was an electronic identification device where a card could be inserted
The three iron gates should be controlled by magnetic cards.
Fang Heng muttered to himself. Then, he took out a small hammer from his backpack and threw it at the iron gate.
"Bang!"
The iron gate had about 750,000 HP.
Fang Heng made a rough estimation in his mind.
With the indefatigable zombie clones, it wasn't impossible to break it open.
However, the time spent was too long, and the gains didn't make up for the losses.

[Hint: Currently, the target that is selected to be disassembled is a special item. It is triggered by a mission. If it is destroyed by force, the mission item may be destroyed. The mission will disappear or fail. Please be careful.]
Alright.
"Looks like I can't open it with brute force."
Fang Heng shrugged and put away the small stone hammer. He completely dismissed the idea of using brute force.
"Let's go. We'll go somewhere else to take a look first."
After returning to the fork, Fang Heng walked to the right to investigate.
There was an iron gate.
However, this iron gate was open.
The iron gate hung high up.
When the electronic lock was triggered, the iron gate would be lowered, completely cutting off the passageway between Building No. 2 and Building No. 3.
Liao Bufan stuck his head out and looked inside the passageway.
It was pitch black inside.
"The power supply in Building No. 2 is broken. Do you want to go in and take a look?"
"No, I'm not interested."
Liao Bufan quickly retracted his head.
Exploring in the dark was courting death. Any mutated zombie could kill him.
"I think the spider zombies we met before probably came out from this place."
"I think so too. There might be more mutated zombies inside. We'd better find a way to seal this place."
The two of them discussed and returned to the warehouse room in front of the fork in the passage.
Fang Heng tried to turn the door handle.
The door was locked.
"Key."
Yes.
A set of keys was left by the foolish policeman.
Fang Heng tried unlocking the door with the keys.
Soon, he found the key to the warehouse door.
He carefully pushed open the door.
In the warehouse, six bodies were lying on the ground.
They had been dead for a while.
Five of them were wearing prison guard uniforms, but the middle-aged man in the middle was wearing a suit.
He was a little fat and held a pistol in his hand.
He had killed himself with his pistol.
Was it the warden?
Fang Heng had seen the warden's photo in his memory.
It was similar to this middle-aged man who had committed suicide.
The warden's appearance here was too sudden. Was there a clue on him?
Fang Heng tried to walk forward and pull out the pistol in the warden's hand. Then, he tried to touch his pocket.
Sure enough, there was something!
[Hint: You have obtained the prison management magnetic card-C.]
Item: Prison management magnetic card-C.
Description: Special mission item. It can open the iron gate found in the prison's basement.]
Fang Heng immediately thought of the iron gate he saw just now.
Needless to say, this magnetic card could control the iron gate.
Then, Fang Heng dug into the pockets of the other guards and confiscated all their firearms.
[Hint: You have obtained the prison guard's handgun*5, ordinary handgun bullets*243.]
"Fang Heng, come and take a look!"
Liao Bufan, who was searching around the room, shouted. His tone was full of surprise.
"Look! Good stuff!"
Liao Bufan pointed at the locked weapon box.
"Do you have the key in your hand?"
Fang Heng suddenly understood and took out the set of keys.
The lock on the weapon box was very different from the lock on the door.
Fang Heng quickly found the corresponding key and opened the weapon box with a click.
[Hint: You have received sniper rifle*3, you have received sniper rifle bullets*120.]
"F*ck! It's a sniper rifle!"
Liao Bufan couldn't help but shout out.
"We're rich!"
In the game, sniper rifles were a great weapon.
It was the same regardless of the early, middle and late stages in the game.
After hitting the player, it almost had a 100% crippling effect.
If it grazed the arm, one of the arms would be blown off, and if it grazed the scalp, the head would be split open.
Fang Heng couldn't help but reach out to touch the muzzle of the rifle.
It was indeed a good item.
In his memory, the sniper rifle only appeared in the later stages of the game.
After changing to armour-piercing bullets, it was one of the few guns that could deal damage to the corpse king.
The federation had given the gun data before. For an average player to fully control this weapon, they would need to attain at least Level 10 gun mastery and 10 strength points.
[Hint: You have completed the second stage of the mission-explore the basement.]
[Hint: You have obtained 540 survival points.]
[Hint: The third stage of the mission has been triggered.]
[Mission: Explore the second basement of the prison.]
Mission name: Explore the second basement of the prison.

Mission description: You have discovered an unmarked hidden area in the basement of the prison. It leads to the second basement. Please try to enter the second basement without destroying the main building of the prison.
Mission reward: Survival points.
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a moment after receiving the mission.
"Let's go and try the magnetic card first."
Fang Heng patted Liao Bufan's shoulder.
The two of them returned to the front of the iron gate again. Fang Heng tried to insert the magnetic card into the slot on the wall.
"Beep Beep Beep..."
"Verified!"
"Boom!"
The iron gate connecting Building No. 2 and Building No. 3 slowly descended.
Liao Bufan looked at the darkness behind the iron gate and could not help but swallow his saliva.
"I keep feeling like there's something scary inside. Closing the gate makes me feel a lot better."
Fang Heng felt the same way. He vaguely felt that something was staring at them in the darkness, making him feel uneasy.
After closing the iron gate, the feeling of being stared at became much weaker.
"Yes, we'll deal with Building No. 2 in the future. In short, we can build the shelter in peace."
Liao Bufan nodded repeatedly.
They could finally rest for the next few days.
Before he left, Fang Heng went to the other passageway to test it out.
After some testing, the magnetic card found in the warden's hand could open one of the three iron gates leading to the second basement.
As for the remaining two iron gates, they were still closed.
According to Fang Heng's years of gaming experience, he felt that the remaining two magnetic cards could only be found by entering Building No. 1 and Building No. 2.
"How troublesome!"
What kind of secret was hidden in this prison?
It was only the second stage of this mission and they had to face a large number of mutated zombies. The difficulty level for the third stage would be even higher!
Fang Heng scratched his head in annoyance.
At the moment, forcefully exploring Buildings No. 1 and 2 was too dangerous.
They could only wait until the shelter was completed.
Fang Heng decided to put the hidden prison mission aside for now.
At least after cutting off the passageway between Buildings No. 2 and 3, they could temporarily enjoy a period of peace.
Next, they were only one step away from building the shelter.
Nails!
The number of furnaces needed to make nails was not enough, so they needed to buy more.
After killing spider zombies for a day, they had more than 10,000 survival points, which was enough to buy all the remaining furnaces in the apocalypse merchant shop!
With that thought, Fang Heng and Liao Bufan left the basement together.

sentences.text: "What's wrong?"
Fang Heng took out the map of the prison that he had found on the first floor from his backpack and compared it with the terrain of the scene.
"Look, our position on the map is here.
This is the marked warehouse.
There's no problem here.
It's just on our right."
"There's no problem here either.
The passageway that turns left in front is connected to the basement of Building No.
Liao Bufan leaned over to take a look.
It was just as Fang Heng said.
He soon discovered the problem.
"Huh?
The passageway in front of us isn't marked on the map?"
"Yes, and the map doesn't indicate that there's a second basement in the prison."
Fang Heng checked the map repeatedly to confirm.
He then used his hand to pry the railings of the iron gate to check.
The iron gate was unusually heavy and strong.
On the wall of the iron gate, there was an electronic identification device where a card could be inserted
The three iron gates should be controlled by magnetic cards.
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
Then, he took out a small hammer from his backpack and threw it at the iron gate.
"Bang!"
The iron gate had about 750,000 HP.
Fang Heng made a rough estimation in his mind.
With the indefatigable zombie clones, it wasn't impossible to break it open.
However, the time spent was too long, and the gains didn't make up for the losses.
[Hint: Currently, the target that is selected to be disassembled is a special item.
It is triggered by a mission.
If it is destroyed by force, the mission item may be destroyed.
The mission will disappear or fail.
Please be careful.]
Alright.
"Looks like I can't open it with brute force."
Fang Heng shrugged and put away the small stone hammer.
He completely dismissed the idea of using brute force.
"Let's go.
We'll go somewhere else to take a look first."
After returning to the fork, Fang Heng walked to the right to investigate.
There was an iron gate.
However, this iron gate was open.
The iron gate hung high up.
When the electronic lock was triggered, the iron gate would be lowered, completely cutting off the passageway between Building No.
2 and Building No.
Liao Bufan stuck his head out and looked inside the passageway.
It was pitch black inside.
"The power supply in Building No.
2 is broken.
Do you want to go in and take a look?"
"No, I'm not interested."
Liao Bufan quickly retracted his head.
Exploring in the dark was courting death.
Any mutated zombie could kill him.
"I think the spider zombies we met before probably came out from this place."
"I think so too.
There might be more mutated zombies inside.
We'd better find a way to seal this place."
The two of them discussed and returned to the warehouse room in front of the fork in the passage.
Fang Heng tried to turn the door handle.
The door was locked.
"Key."
Yes.
A set of keys was left by the foolish policeman.
Fang Heng tried unlocking the door with the keys.
Soon, he found the key to the warehouse door.
He carefully pushed open the door.
In the warehouse, six bodies were lying on the ground.
They had been dead for a while.
Five of them were wearing prison guard uniforms, but the middle-aged man in the middle was wearing a suit.
He was a little fat and held a pistol in his hand.
He had killed himself with his pistol.
Was it the warden?
Fang Heng had seen the warden's photo in his memory.
It was similar to this middle-aged man who had committed suicide.
The warden's appearance here was too sudden.
Was there a clue on him?
Fang Heng tried to walk forward and pull out the pistol in the warden's hand.
Then, he tried to touch his pocket.
Sure enough, there was something!
[Hint: You have obtained the prison management magnetic card-C.]
Item: Prison management magnetic card-C.
Description: Special mission item.
It can open the iron gate found in the prison's basement.]
Fang Heng immediately thought of the iron gate he saw just now.
Needless to say, this magnetic card could control the iron gate.
Then, Fang Heng dug into the pockets of the other guards and confiscated all their firearms.
[Hint: You have obtained the prison guard's handgun*5, ordinary handgun bullets*243.]
"Fang Heng, come and take a look!"
Liao Bufan, who was searching around the room, shouted.
His tone was full of surprise.
"Look!
Good stuff!"
Liao Bufan pointed at the locked weapon box.
"Do you have the key in your hand?"
Fang Heng suddenly understood and took out the set of keys.
The lock on the weapon box was very different from the lock on the door.
Fang Heng quickly found the corresponding key and opened the weapon box with a click.
[Hint: You have received sniper rifle*3, you have received sniper rifle bullets*120.]
"F*ck!
It's a sniper rifle!"
Liao Bufan couldn't help but shout out.
"We're rich!"
In the game, sniper rifles were a great weapon.
It was the same regardless of the early, middle and late stages in the game.
After hitting the player, it almost had a 100% crippling effect.
If it grazed the arm, one of the arms would be blown off, and if it grazed the scalp, the head would be split open.
Fang Heng couldn't help but reach out to touch the muzzle of the rifle.
It was indeed a good item.
In his memory, the sniper rifle only appeared in the later stages of the game.
After changing to armour-piercing bullets, it was one of the few guns that could deal damage to the corpse king.
The federation had given the gun data before.
For an average player to fully control this weapon, they would need to attain at least Level 10 gun mastery and 10 strength points.
[Hint: You have completed the second stage of the mission-explore the basement.]
[Hint: You have obtained 540 survival points.]
[Hint: The third stage of the mission has been triggered.]
[Mission: Explore the second basement of the prison.]
Mission name: Explore the second basement of the prison.
Mission description: You have discovered an unmarked hidden area in the basement of the prison.
It leads to the second basement.
Please try to enter the second basement without destroying the main building of the prison.
Mission reward: Survival points.
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a moment after receiving the mission.
"Let's go and try the magnetic card first."
Fang Heng patted Liao Bufan's shoulder.
The two of them returned to the front of the iron gate again.
Fang Heng tried to insert the magnetic card into the slot on the wall.
"Beep Beep Beep..."
"Verified!"
"Boom!"
The iron gate connecting Building No.
2 and Building No.
3 slowly descended.
Liao Bufan looked at the darkness behind the iron gate and could not help but swallow his saliva.
"I keep feeling like there's something scary inside.
Closing the gate makes me feel a lot better."
Fang Heng felt the same way.
He vaguely felt that something was staring at them in the darkness, making him feel uneasy.
After closing the iron gate, the feeling of being stared at became much weaker.
"Yes, we'll deal with Building No.
2 in the future.
In short, we can build the shelter in peace."
Liao Bufan nodded repeatedly.
They could finally rest for the next few days.
Before he left, Fang Heng went to the other passageway to test it out.
After some testing, the magnetic card found in the warden's hand could open one of the three iron gates leading to the second basement.
As for the remaining two iron gates, they were still closed.
According to Fang Heng's years of gaming experience, he felt that the remaining two magnetic cards could only be found by entering Building No.

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Where Are the Zombies?
paragraphs: "This..."
"Can someone tell me what happened here?"
On the small slope outside the prison, Lu Yu and Zhou Yi were shocked.
Where were the zombies?
They had worked hard to complete the mission and finally bought the earth-made bombs from the apocalypse merchant.
They were about to come back and blow a hole in the prison's barbed wire fence to release the zombies.
Everything was ready.
But where were the zombies?
Where did the zombies go?
The entire prison was empty. Not even half of the zombies could be seen.
Could it be...
Although Lu Yu already had the answer in his head, he still couldn't help but ask Zhou Yi for confirmation.
"Could it be that someone cleaned up this prison area and took over this prison for themselves?"
Lu Yu felt that this was the closest answer to the truth.
Zhou Yi didn't say anything.
He stood on the small slope in a daze, his eyes a little dull.
Lu Yu nudged Zhou Yi.
"Ah Yi! Wake Up! Wake up quickly."
"Ha."
Zhou Yi came back to his senses. His mouth was bitter as he smiled self-mockingly.
Were all the players so strong these days?
They could single-handedly take care of so many zombies?
Or was he too weak?
He had been dealt too many blows in the past few days!
Now, even the prison mission that he had been planning for so long was taken away by someone!
What a disgrace!
Zhou Yi felt that he was struck by a blow.
He even began to seriously doubt himself.
He felt that he should not have chosen the new server's zombie apocalypse as the company's new goal.
"Boss, don't worry. Even if someone cleaned up the prison square, the mission might not have been triggered yet."
Seeing that Zhou Yi didn't look right, Lu Yu hurriedly tried to console him.
"Building No. 3 is also very dangerous. No matter how fast that player is, he can't possibly clean up both the prison square and Building No. 3 together!"
"Yes, you're right!"
Zhou Yi patted his cheeks to cheer himself up.
He hadn't lost yet!
He couldn't afford to lose!
Now, his entire company was betting on this game.
Failure meant that all the years of hard work had been in vain and the family business had been destroyed in his hands.
It wasn't time to admit defeat yet!
Zhou Yi forced himself to cheer up.
"Let's go into Building No. 3 together and check it out. Confirm that inside..."
Zhou Yi stopped mid-sentence.
He saw that a window on the second floor of Building No. 3 had been opened from inside.
Then, a chubby head popped out from inside.
It was a survivor!
He stuck his head out from the window in boredom and looked out at the scenery. He held a skewer of grilled meat in his left hand and a bottle of beer in his right hand.
He looked like he had nothing to worry about.
Seeing this, Zhou Yi fell into silence once again.
The confidence that he had just built up was instantly destroyed by more than half.
Lu Yu was also unable to say anything for a long time.
Now, they could be sure that not only the entire prison square, even Building No. 3 had been completely cleaned up by a group of players...
Moreover, this group of people were living quite comfortably.
"Cheer up, Boss!"
"Even so, it can only mean that they cleaned up Building No. 3!"
"We still have a chance! What if they didn't find the diary left by the prison officers?"
"That thing was hidden so well, Building No. 3 is so big and there are so many cabinets on the second floor. Ordinary people wouldn't even think of going to the mezzanine."
Yes, there was still hope.
"I haven't lost yet!"
Zhou Yi raised his head again and muttered to himself as if he was trying to convince himself.
"Come, let's go in and talk to the people inside."
The two of them walked down the slope and waved at Liao Bufan at the window on the second floor.
Liao Bufan saw the two sneaky people, threw away the beer bottle and jumped off the platform on the second floor.
He carefully walked forward and asked through the three layers of barbed wire.
"Hey, you two have been watching over there for a long time, right? What are you here for?"
Zhou Yi adjusted his emotions and stood outside the barbed wire to maintain a safe distance from Liao Bufan.
"Hello, we have no bad intentions. I am the boss of Soaring Gaming Technology Company. I happened to pass by here and want to discuss a collaboration with your boss. Is your boss inside now?"
In his heart, Zhou Yi had already tacitly acknowledged that the other party was a gaming company or a player guild team.
Zhou Yi frowned.
"Eh? Boss? You're here to look for Fang Heng?"
Fang Heng!?
This name shocked Zhou Yi and Lu Yu.
It was him? That God?
What the hell! So it wasn't a gaming company!
It was God!
He cleared out the entire prison!
But on second thought, it made sense.
Besides him, who else could empty the entire prison square and the zombies in Building No. 3?
Zhou Yi felt bitter in his heart.
After all this time, it was still him.
Lu Yu had an idea and quickly replied.
"Right, right, right. We're all friends of Fang Heng. I've added him as a friend before. My name is Lu Yu."
Liao Bufan rolled his eyes. He turned on his survival radio and sent an emergency message to Fang Heng.
Coincidentally, Fang Heng was still in the prison today.
Liao Bufan: "Fang Heng, someone said that they're from some company and they're here to work with you. One of them said that he's your friend, Lu Yu."
Fang Heng: "There is such a person. Take them to the sentry cabin first. I'll be right there."
After receiving Fang Heng's confirmation, Liao Bufan nodded to Lu Yu and Fang Heng.
"Alright then, follow me to the cabin."
Liao Bufan said as he took out a pistol from his backpack and pointed it at the cabin on the side.
"Let's be clear, don't try to play any tricks!"
When he saw Liao Bufan taking out the pistol, Zhou Yi's heart jumped.
Gun!
He turned to look at Lu Yu.
It was a gun!
The mission that they had spent money to buy stated that the reward for completing the first stage of the prison's hidden mission was a pistol!
Lu Yu did not notice Zhou Yi's gaze and asked in surprise, "You, you already have a gun?"
"Hehe, not bad, right? I found it in the prison."
When Zhou Yi heard that, his face turned ashen and he could not say a word.
It was over!
It was all over!
The prison guard's diary must have been discovered.
What was worse was that they had even completed the first stage of the mission and found the safe that the prison guard had left behind.
All their efforts over the past few days had been in vain...
Lu Yu's smile was abnormally awkward.
"Then... Then you guys are amazing."
"Hehe, isn't that right?"
The surprised expressions on the two people's faces made Liao Bufan feel quite pleased.
These two days, he had also been greatly triggered by Fang Heng.
He needed to find a place to vent his frustration and calm his mind.
These two people were not bad at all.
Liao Bufan continued to brag about himself.
"Good fellow, you guys don't know that this prison is not that simple. There is a basement inside."
The expression on both Lu Yu and Zhou Yi changed in unison.
Basement!
The basement of the second stage of the mission was extremely difficult. One had to pass through a long passageway in the basement.
Could it be...
Could it be that he has already started working on the second stage of the mission?
