chapters.title: Chapter 35: Super-large Shelter
paragraphs: "Hehehe!"
Liao Bufan laughed and kept them guessing.
"Why don't you guess what's in the basement? You'll never guess."
Zhou Yi quickly asked.
"What's in there?"
"Let me tell you, it's full of spider zombies! Those things are much stronger than normal mutant zombies!"
"D*mn! There were so many spider zombies in the entire tunnel. You should have seen them. Tsk, tsk, tsk..."
Zhou Yi carefully looked at Liao Bufan and asked him for confirmation.
"So, you all didn't pass through the basement?"
"How is that possible? It's just a spider zombie. They're just unlucky to meet me."
Liao Bufan told the two about how he had killed the spider zombies and also tried to weaken Fang Heng's role in this operation.
"You... you killed all those spider zombies by yourself?"
Zhou Yi showed a terrified expression.
Then, he felt helpless.
In this shelter, Fang Heng was already very strong but his companion was also so strong?
Why was this game so hard to play?
Zhou Yi's desire to retire became stronger and stronger.
At this time, Fang Heng pushed the door open and entered.
"So it's you two."
Fang Heng was familiar with these two people.
In his memory, he had met them twice outside the apocalypse merchant camp.
"I heard you want to work with me?"
Lu Yu looked at Zhou Yi who was silent.
He was dealt with a heavy blow.
At first, he did want to seek cooperation.
But now, he knew that Fang Heng had already completed both stages of the hidden mission.
What was there to cooperate?
He didn't know what to do for the follow-up of the mission! Unless he continued to spend money and buy information from those "black agents".
"Do you want to cooperate?"
Fang Heng saw that the two of them were quiet, so he broke the silence first.
"Then how about this? I have a job here, and I want to find someone to help. I think you guys are pretty good."
A job? Help?
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other.
After more than 20 minutes, they walked out of the sentry cabin.
It was strange. They were looking for Fang Heng to cooperate with them to complete the hidden mission in the beginning.
How did it turn into working for someone else in the blink of an eye?
"Sigh!"
Zhou Yi let out a long sigh.
The price offered by the other party was too hard to refuse!
Two days later.
In the prison's basement.
Fang Heng stood at the inner side of the pathway.
He opened the game construction page and finally adjusted the location of the shelter.
"Let's do it here."
After thinking for a while, he finally set the shelter next to the underground warehouse.
[Hint: The player has decided on the location of the shelter. The location is confirmed to be ready for construction.]
[Hint: After the construction is completed, all items in the location will be cleared.]

[Hint: Your shelter blueprint (modified) has been modified. It has been determined to be a basic super-large shelter (maximum expansion can be made later). Currently, you will need to consume wooden planks*29,813, wooden frames*26,712, nails*6891, iron blocks*90, small stones*6671, firewood*27,111.]
[Player, do you want to build it?]
"Not a problem."
Fang Heng reached out to confirm.
The concrete wall in front of him gradually turned into a basic wooden door.
[Hint: Player's shelter has been built and modified.]
Fang Heng pushed the door open and entered.
The inner area of the shelter was very large. There was only a complete hall, which was half the size of a football field.
Currently, there was nothing in the hall except for a few pillars that were used to support it.
Specifically, the interior could be divided into small rooms later.
This step could be modified through the blueprint later.
It only required some materials, which was not difficult.
Fang Heng could also use more materials to cover the wider area around the shelter.
Or he could use more advanced materials to strengthen the shelter.
[Hint: The system has determined that your shelter can accommodate up to 18 players. If you exceed the capacity, your shelter will be more vulnerable to zombie attacks at night.]
At the same time, all the players in District 8, including Fang Heng, received two simple messages in their game logs.
[Hint: The first super-large player shelter has been established.]
[Hint: The next blood moon zombie wave will occur in 21 days.]
Most ordinary players automatically ignored these two messages.
However, on a certain high-threshold elite player forum, these two messages were immediately reposted and topped the list, causing a huge uproar.
The more they understood the zombie apocalypse game, the more they felt that this piece of news was terrifying.
How many days had passed since the game started?
There was an influential power that had already established a super-large shelter?
In the past, the first to establish a super-large shelter must have been the federal government!
Only they had powerful manpower and resources.
But this time, the tradition was broken.
The federal government did not issue an announcement, which meant that this shelter was not established by the Federation.
There was someone who could complete it before the Federation?
Who could it be?
Which large guild or gaming company?
Why didn't any news leak out?
There was a lot of discussion for this post.
The server for District 8 had opened for less than 10 days and the players had already established the shelter.
This was a historical event!

The internet was buzzing with discussion about this matter. In reality, the players' clubs and the directors and bosses of gaming companies who were familiar with each other began to probe one another.
"Brother Liu, Congratulations! You're the first to complete a super-large shelter. Please take care of us in the future..."
"It's not me. I'm also wondering who could be so amazing."
"If it wasn't you, who else could it be? We've been friends for so many years and you're still playing games with me?"
"I'm not lying to you. It can't be you, right? You want to turn the tables on me?"
Everyone was waiting for any company to announce the news.
However, after waiting for a long time, the forum was still silent.
No one claimed it.
No one knew who established this shelter.
Except for Lu Yu and Zhou Yi.
The two of them looked at each other on their motorcycles.
After a long silence, Zhou Yi's throat rolled.
"It can't be... him, right?"
Lu Yu shrugged.
"Who else could it be?"
"D*mn! We can't play this game anymore!"
"There are 21 days until the zombie wave. You have to think carefully. Should we build our shelter or what?"
Zhou Yi took a deep breath.
He tried hard to get rid of distracting thoughts, forcing himself not to think about Fang Heng.
"In a few days, when a new batch of employees arrives, we'll build a small shelter first."
"Okay."
Lu Yu nodded.
They had to hurry.
After the first super-large player shelter was built, the King of Gods would give an early warning of the next blood moon zombie wave.
There were only 21 days left.
This meant that they had to complete the construction of the shelter within 21 days.
The Federation had released statistics three years ago.

In the zombie apocalypse game, during the first six months of the game's launch, the death rate of players who did not stay in an effective shelter during the day of the blood moon was as high as 70%.
Even if they stayed in the shelter, the death rate still exceeded 20%.
Very few guilds had chosen to build super-large shelters because of the blood moon zombie wave.
Rather than wait for death in a super-large shelter, it would be better to build a small shelter...

sentences.text: "Hehehe!"
Liao Bufan laughed and kept them guessing.
"Why don't you guess what's in the basement?
You'll never guess."
Zhou Yi quickly asked.
"What's in there?"
"Let me tell you, it's full of spider zombies!
Those things are much stronger than normal mutant zombies!"
"D*mn!
There were so many spider zombies in the entire tunnel.
You should have seen them.
Tsk, tsk, tsk..."
Zhou Yi carefully looked at Liao Bufan and asked him for confirmation.
"So, you all didn't pass through the basement?"
"How is that possible?
It's just a spider zombie.
They're just unlucky to meet me."
Liao Bufan told the two about how he had killed the spider zombies and also tried to weaken Fang Heng's role in this operation.
"You... you killed all those spider zombies by yourself?"
Zhou Yi showed a terrified expression.
Then, he felt helpless.
In this shelter, Fang Heng was already very strong but his companion was also so strong?
Why was this game so hard to play?
Zhou Yi's desire to retire became stronger and stronger.
At this time, Fang Heng pushed the door open and entered.
"So it's you two."
Fang Heng was familiar with these two people.
In his memory, he had met them twice outside the apocalypse merchant camp.
"I heard you want to work with me?"
Lu Yu looked at Zhou Yi who was silent.
He was dealt with a heavy blow.
At first, he did want to seek cooperation.
But now, he knew that Fang Heng had already completed both stages of the hidden mission.
What was there to cooperate?
He didn't know what to do for the follow-up of the mission!
Unless he continued to spend money and buy information from those "black agents".
"Do you want to cooperate?"
Fang Heng saw that the two of them were quiet, so he broke the silence first.
"Then how about this?
I have a job here, and I want to find someone to help.
I think you guys are pretty good."
A job?
Help?
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other.
After more than 20 minutes, they walked out of the sentry cabin.
It was strange.
They were looking for Fang Heng to cooperate with them to complete the hidden mission in the beginning.
How did it turn into working for someone else in the blink of an eye?
"Sigh!"
Zhou Yi let out a long sigh.
The price offered by the other party was too hard to refuse!
Two days later.
In the prison's basement.
Fang Heng stood at the inner side of the pathway.
He opened the game construction page and finally adjusted the location of the shelter.
"Let's do it here."
After thinking for a while, he finally set the shelter next to the underground warehouse.

The location is confirmed to be ready for construction.]
[Hint: After the construction is completed, all items in the location will be cleared.]
[Hint: Your shelter blueprint (modified) has been modified.
It has been determined to be a basic super-large shelter (maximum expansion can be made later).
Currently, you will need to consume wooden planks*29,813, wooden frames*26,712, nails*6891, iron blocks*90, small stones*6671, firewood*27,111.]
[Player, do you want to build it?]

Fang Heng reached out to confirm.
The concrete wall in front of him gradually turned into a basic wooden door.
[Hint: Player's shelter has been built and modified.]
Fang Heng pushed the door open and entered.
The inner area of the shelter was very large.
There was only a complete hall, which was half the size of a football field.
Currently, there was nothing in the hall except for a few pillars that were used to support it.
Specifically, the interior could be divided into small rooms later.
This step could be modified through the blueprint later.
It only required some materials, which was not difficult.
Fang Heng could also use more materials to cover the wider area around the shelter.
Or he could use more advanced materials to strengthen the shelter.
[Hint: The system has determined that your shelter can accommodate up to 18 players.
If you exceed the capacity, your shelter will be more vulnerable to zombie attacks at night.]
At the same time, all the players in District 8, including Fang Heng, received two simple messages in their game logs.
[Hint: The first super-large player shelter has been established.]
[Hint: The next blood moon zombie wave will occur in 21 days.]
Most ordinary players automatically ignored these two messages.
However, on a certain high-threshold elite player forum, these two messages were immediately reposted and topped the list, causing a huge uproar.
The more they understood the zombie apocalypse game, the more they felt that this piece of news was terrifying.
How many days had passed since the game started?
There was an influential power that had already established a super-large shelter?
In the past, the first to establish a super-large shelter must have been the federal government!
Only they had powerful manpower and resources.
But this time, the tradition was broken.
The federal government did not issue an announcement, which meant that this shelter was not established by the Federation.
There was someone who could complete it before the Federation?
Who could it be?
Which large guild or gaming company?
Why didn't any news leak out?
There was a lot of discussion for this post.
The server for District 8 had opened for less than 10 days and the players had already established the shelter.
This was a historical event!
The internet was buzzing with discussion about this matter.
In reality, the players' clubs and the directors and bosses of gaming companies who were familiar with each other began to probe one another.
"Brother Liu, Congratulations!
You're the first to complete a super-large shelter.
Please take care of us in the future..."
"It's not me.
I'm also wondering who could be so amazing."
"If it wasn't you, who else could it be?
We've been friends for so many years and you're still playing games with me?"
"I'm not lying to you.
It can't be you, right?
You want to turn the tables on me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Danger Perception
paragraphs: [Hint: As the first player in this world to complete a super-large shelter, you have obtained a random B-class skill book*1 reward.]
[Hint: You have obtained a skill book: animal instinct-danger perception (soul binding).]
"Eh? There's such a good thing? I've never heard of it before."
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
There was a skill book in his backpack.
Item: Animal instinct-danger perception (soul binding).
Type: Skill book (player has not mastered this skill).
Description: Skill that can be mastered after learning: animal instinct-danger perception, player's basic perception attribute +10, it is easier for the player to detect the impending danger.
Description: Soul binding, not tradable.
"Good stuff! I got basic attribute 10 points just like that!"
Fang Heng tapped the skill book on his head and a faint light lit up.
[Hint: Player's learning skill: animal instinct-danger perception (Level: Max).]
[Hint: Under the influence of the skill, your basic perception attribute +10.]
"Eh?"
After learning the skill, Fang Heng immediately noticed the change.
It was an indescribable feeling.
He felt that the world seemed to have become clearer.
He could see clearer than before, and he could hear further.
Perhaps this was the effect of the perception ability.
"In actual combat, I should be able to aim more accurately using the gun than before, right?"
Fang Heng shrugged, quickly getting used to this change.
According to the plan, Fang Heng would only temporarily use the shelter as a storage point. He, Liao Bufan, Liu Lin and the others would stay in the prison's Building No. 3 for now.
After all, the basement was a bit far from the ground, and running up and down was troublesome.
"It's finally done!"
Step by step, he had reached this day. Looking at the newly built shelter, Fang Heng still had a great sense of achievement.
"Building the shelter is only the first step."
Fang Heng whispered.
He had a foothold in the game now.
He was still far from a real foothold!
Fang Heng cheered up.
Next, it was time to think about recruiting.
Fang Heng walked to the corner of the shelter and opened the construction page.
Item: Large survival radio station.
Description: There are still a lot of survivors in the apocalypse. You can try to summon them through the survival radio station.
Construction requirement 1: Player has a small or higher level shelter.
Construction requirement 2: Player's basic production level must be Level 3 or above.
Fang Heng spent ten minutes completing a large survival radio station and placed it in the corner of the shelter.
The survivors in the description referred to ordinary NPCs.
As the owner of the shelter, Fang Heng could recruit NPCs through the survival radio station to work for the shelter.
Ordinary NPCs only had the most common skills, such as felling, manufacturing and so on. They did not have the same talent as players.
Their basic attributes were no different from rookie players' Level 1. Moreover, their learning ability was low and the efficiency of upgrading skills was extremely slow.
They also had a limit to their energy points. They needed rest, food and clean houses to live in...
Once these things were lacking, their sense of belonging would be reduced.
Once it was reduced to a certain limit, the survivor NPCs would choose to leave the shelter voluntarily, which would affect the popularity of the shelter.
Fang Heng felt that when these ordinary NPCs worked, they would be attacked by the zombies and split into pieces.
As long as Fang Heng dared to let them go out and search for materials, they would die in the wild!
100% mortality rate!
Although these survivors had great limitations, they also had advantages.
They had much higher intelligence and loyalty than the zombie clones.
Fang Heng was sure of one thing.
Players would betray them.
But the NPCs that were controlled by the system would never betray them.
In the game, there were more than one or two incidents where a large guild exposed a certain player's betrayal.
Large-scale incidents such as Mission: Impossible, Honey Trap, Black-and-White and Infernal Affairs happened almost once or twice a year. Even the federal government intervened.
It was common for some large companies to be betrayed and go bankrupt.
All kinds of events would cause a stir among the players and become the gossip of the public.
There were too many scandals!
Fang Heng had made plans for his future.
He would use NPCs to act as guards of the shelter to eliminate internal threats.
Fang Heng walked to the radio station and turned on the survival radio to enquire.
Shelter owner: Fang Heng.
Shelter level: Super-large.
Shelter attractiveness: 29 (this value is related to shelter size, resources, military strength, cleanliness and the satisfaction of the people in the shelter).
The current number of survivors available for recruitment: 3 (every 3 days, 3 survivors will be available for recruitment; the current maximum number of survivors stored: 29).
Description: The more attractive a shelter is, the easier it is to attract survivors to seek refuge. Once a survivor leaves the shelter, the number will decrease slightly for some time.
This was Fang Heng's first time coming into contact with the game recruitment system.
In his memory, in the previous server, he had only built a small single-person shelter, so he was unable to recruit survivors.
The more troublesome thing was that NPC survivors were also counted by 'heads'.
With one more NPC survivor, the shelter's capacity would be +1.
What was worse was that the newly recruited survivors were all hungry.
In the early stages, normal players really could not afford to feed them.
Fang Heng waved his hand and recruited all three survivor NPCs through the radio station.
Anyway, he had the zombie clones now, so the shelter had plenty of materials, so it was not a problem to provide food for these refugees.
Because of the existence of the zombie clones, they did not need so many ordinary NPC survivors. They only needed a few people to maintain the cleanliness and daily operations of the shelter.
At most, they could wait until the shelter was expanded before continuing to recruit more.
After the recruitment was completed, they could do all the chores and transportation in the prison.
They were much smarter than the zombie clones and they worked very hard.
Soon, three refugees appeared at the entrance of the prison.
Fang Heng brought them back to Building No. 3 of the prison and gave them enough food.
"Thank you so much. The zombies outside are too scary. I haven't eaten for days! I will repay you!"
"Thank you, Fang Heng. Thank you so much for letting us stay in the shelter. We will do our best."
A blonde female survivor was very grateful and thanked Fang Heng.
"I have plenty of food here, but this is not for free. You need to work for the shelter in exchange for protection."
Fang Heng pointed to the hall on the first floor.
"I need you to be responsible for cleaning up and sorting out the materials."
"Clean up a few rooms as soon as possible. You can each choose a room to live in."
"Okay, we will do it as soon as possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 37: NPC Mercenaries
paragraphs: In the apocalypse world game, two types of NPCs could be recruited.
One was the basic NPC survivors that could be recruited through the survival radio station.
They were unable to participate in battle and could barely use their weapons to kill zombies. There was a high chance that they would be killed by the zombies.
The other type had the skill of gun mastery and could use all kinds of basic firearms. The attributes of their characters were also higher than those of ordinary survivors.
Players usually call them "mercenaries".
However, recruiting mercenaries were not free.
Fang Heng needed to spend some survival points for this.
Riding the mountain bike, Fang Heng arrived at the apocalypse camp.
"Hahahaha! Fang Heng! You're here! I was just talking to my friends about you. I heard that you've completed the shelter?"
"You're really well-informed."
"Hahaha!"
Vettel looked very happy. He laughed loudly.
"Of course. In our line of work, first-hand information usually means wealth!"
"Oh right, do you need help? I have a lot of people whom I can recommend to you, but you know..."
Fang Heng blinked at Vettel.
"I understand. I need to spend survival points to recruit, right?"
"Don't worry, I will give you the lowest price. However, there is one thing. If they die in battle, you will have to pay an additional amount of survival points as a pension."
"I understand."
Fang Heng shrugged.
In major forums of the game, players had been criticizing the pension.
It was too expensive!
Players aside, even if it was a large guild, if a few mercenaries under them were to suddenly die in the early stages, it would be extremely "painful" to them.
For ordinary players, they would not even consider recruiting mercenaries.
The risk was too great. If one mercenary died, what they had accumulated in half a year would be lost.
At the moment, Fang Heng believed that the prison's defensive ability could easily defend against zombies.
But what about players?
In the zombie apocalypse game, the biggest threat was still the human survivors.
Fang Heng needed to recruit mercenaries to improve the prison's defensive ability.
This was something that the zombie clones couldn't do at the moment.
Fang Heng wasn't willing to deal with players.
It was too risky.
He was more willing to trust NPC mercenaries who wouldn't betray him.
"Vettel, is there anyone here willing to come to my camp? I'll pay them."
"Of course."
Vettel waved his hand and a floating recruitment list appeared in front of Fang Heng.
There were about 50 survivor mercenaries, all of them were Level 1 to 5.
Fang Heng skimmed through it.
Among them, the three highest level mercenaries were at Level 5 and they also had Level 5 gun mastery.
Fang Heng remembered seeing a post in an official player forum that said that Level 5 was the highest level for the mercenaries.
He could not skimp on safety! If he wanted to buy, he had to buy the strongest!
Fang Heng selected three mercenaries.
"Are you sure you want to recruit them? Recruiting a survivor requires 6,000 survival points."
"If he unfortunately dies in battle, you will need to spend an additional 30,000 survival points as compensation."
"I am sure."
[Hint: You have spent 1,800,000 survival points to recruit three survivors. They will report outside your shelter in three hours.]
Alright.
After purchasing three mercenaries, Fang Heng's savings that he had accumulated during this period was completely used up.
He now had less than 500 survival points left.
"Very good, I will immediately tell them. They will report to your shelter in three hours."
"Thank you."
Fang Heng waved his hand, but in his heart, he was thinking how expensive it was!
There was a limit to the number of mercenaries that could be recruited from the apocalypse camp. It was on a "first come, first served" basis.
Currently, he was the only one in the game who had established a shelter, so there were no competitors to compete with him for mercenaries.
Once the players had developed, high-level mercenaries would become a resource that would be taken over by large player guilds or gaming companies.
Fang Heng casually said, "Vettel, if you encounter stronger survivors, remember to introduce them to me at any time."
"Okay, looks like you're short of people there?"
Huh?
Fang Heng was about to leave when he heard that and raised his eyebrows.
This question made him smell the scent of a mission.
"I'm quite short of people. Vettel, we're good friends. Do you have any suggestions for me?"
"Hahaha! Of course. You're one of my best friends. After all, you've always helped in my business."
Vetter laughed loudly.
He leaned over and whispered in Fang Heng's ear.
"Did you forget about the Dark Knights that I mentioned to you before?"
Fang Heng immediately recalled.
Yes! Dark Knights!
Hidden mission.
"I had to go all the way to the city hospital to look for the T-virus antidote, right!" he recalled.
"I'll tell you in secret. After you join the Dark Knights, you can recruit people from the Dark Knights."
Vettel secretly revealed the information to Fang Heng.
"Believe me, the Dark Knights are all first-class players with top-notch strength. Recruiting them is an advantage."
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
There was actually such a saying?
There was a mercenary whose level was even higher than Level 5?
He did not know anything about this in the past!
As expected, even the so-called official game forum could not be trusted.
It even said that a Level 5 mercenary represented the strongest combat strength!
The real secrets were all in the hands of the big guilds.
Fang Heng cursed in his heart and quickly lowered his head to think.
It was not a good idea to keep the Dark Knight mission on hold.
Now that he had time, it was time to make a trip to the city.
The sooner the better, while the other players had yet to establish a shelter, to seize the opportunity.
It was best to recruit all the powerful mercenaries!
One step ahead, one step ahead!
Fang Heng's heart was once again burning with passion.
He had to go to the city this time!
However, it was still very dangerous to enter the city at the current stage. Before that, he still needed to make some preparations.
Fang Heng raised his head.
"Vettel, show me your sales list again..."
"Of course."
Fang Heng opened the list and carefully observed it.
There was a very high probability of encountering mutated zombies in the city. He desperately needed the ability to protect himself.
Shotgun. It was capable of inflicting great damage at close range.
The disadvantage was that he needed 6.5 strength points to use it. He needed 8 strength points to control it perfectly and 10 strength points to completely negate the recoil effect.
Fang Heng looked at his own attributes.
Player: Fang Heng
Level: 9
Vitality: 100/100
Spirit: 100/100
Energy: 83/100
Strength: 6.8
Agility: 6.8
Physique: 6.8
Will: 5
Perception: 15
Intelligence: 5
"That's enough, I'll just use it."
"I'll take it." he thought.
A small explosive pack.
Whether it was used to attack zombies or to destroy buildings, it was an extremely effective tool.
He also wanted them!
First aid spray.
He also needed to prepare a life-saving item...
Fang Heng roughly estimated that he needed at least 40,000 survival points to buy these items.
He had to think of a way to earn points first.

Fang Heng shrugged.
In major forums of the game, players had been criticizing the pension.
It was too expensive!
Players aside, even if it was a large guild, if a few mercenaries under them were to suddenly die in the early stages, it would be extremely "painful" to them.
For ordinary players, they would not even consider recruiting mercenaries.
The risk was too great.
If one mercenary died, what they had accumulated in half a year would be lost.
At the moment, Fang Heng believed that the prison's defensive ability could easily defend against zombies.
But what about players?
In the zombie apocalypse game, the biggest threat was still the human survivors.
Fang Heng needed to recruit mercenaries to improve the prison's defensive ability.
This was something that the zombie clones couldn't do at the moment.
Fang Heng wasn't willing to deal with players.
It was too risky.
He was more willing to trust NPC mercenaries who wouldn't betray him.
"Vettel, is there anyone here willing to come to my camp?
I'll pay them."
"Of course."
Vettel waved his hand and a floating recruitment list appeared in front of Fang Heng.
There were about 50 survivor mercenaries, all of them were Level 1 to 5.
Fang Heng skimmed through it.
Among them, the three highest level mercenaries were at Level 5 and they also had Level 5 gun mastery.
Fang Heng remembered seeing a post in an official player forum that said that Level 5 was the highest level for the mercenaries.
He could not skimp on safety!
If he wanted to buy, he had to buy the strongest!
Fang Heng selected three mercenaries.
"Are you sure you want to recruit them?
Recruiting a survivor requires 6,000 survival points."
"If he unfortunately dies in battle, you will need to spend an additional 30,000 survival points as compensation."
"I am sure."
[Hint: You have spent 1,800,000 survival points to recruit three survivors.
They will report outside your shelter in three hours.]
Alright.
After purchasing three mercenaries, Fang Heng's savings that he had accumulated during this period was completely used up.
He now had less than 500 survival points left.
"Very good, I will immediately tell them.
They will report to your shelter in three hours."
"Thank you."
Fang Heng waved his hand, but in his heart, he was thinking how expensive it was!
There was a limit to the number of mercenaries that could be recruited from the apocalypse camp.
It was on a "first come, first served" basis.
Currently, he was the only one in the game who had established a shelter, so there were no competitors to compete with him for mercenaries.
Once the players had developed, high-level mercenaries would become a resource that would be taken over by large player guilds or gaming companies.
Fang Heng casually said, "Vettel, if you encounter stronger survivors, remember to introduce them to me at any time."
"Okay, looks like you're short of people there?"
Huh?
Fang Heng was about to leave when he heard that and raised his eyebrows.
This question made him smell the scent of a mission.
"I'm quite short of people.
Vettel, we're good friends.
Do you have any suggestions for me?"
"Hahaha!
Of course.
You're one of my best friends.
After all, you've always helped in my business."
Vetter laughed loudly.
He leaned over and whispered in Fang Heng's ear.
"Did you forget about the Dark Knights that I mentioned to you before?"
Fang Heng immediately recalled.
Yes!
Dark Knights!
Hidden mission.
"I had to go all the way to the city hospital to look for the T-virus antidote, right!" he recalled.
"I'll tell you in secret.
After you join the Dark Knights, you can recruit people from the Dark Knights."
Vettel secretly revealed the information to Fang Heng.
"Believe me, the Dark Knights are all first-class players with top-notch strength.
Recruiting them is an advantage."
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
There was actually such a saying?
There was a mercenary whose level was even higher than Level 5?
He did not know anything about this in the past!
As expected, even the so-called official game forum could not be trusted.
It even said that a Level 5 mercenary represented the strongest combat strength!
The real secrets were all in the hands of the big guilds.
Fang Heng cursed in his heart and quickly lowered his head to think.
It was not a good idea to keep the Dark Knight mission on hold.
Now that he had time, it was time to make a trip to the city.
The sooner the better, while the other players had yet to establish a shelter, to seize the opportunity.
It was best to recruit all the powerful mercenaries!
One step ahead, one step ahead!
Fang Heng's heart was once again burning with passion.
He had to go to the city this time!
However, it was still very dangerous to enter the city at the current stage.
Before that, he still needed to make some preparations.
Fang Heng raised his head.
"Vettel, show me your sales list again..."
"Of course."
Fang Heng opened the list and carefully observed it.
There was a very high probability of encountering mutated zombies in the city.
He desperately needed the ability to protect himself.
Shotgun.
It was capable of inflicting great damage at close range.
The disadvantage was that he needed 6.5 strength points to use it.
He needed 8 strength points to control it perfectly and 10 strength points to completely negate the recoil effect.
Fang Heng looked at his own attributes.
Player: Fang Heng
Level: 9
Vitality: 100/100
Spirit: 100/100
Energy: 83/100
Strength: 6.8
Agility: 6.8
Physique: 6.8
Will: 5
Perception: 15
Intelligence: 5
"That's enough, I'll just use it."
"I'll take it." he thought.
A small explosive pack.
Whether it was used to attack zombies or to destroy buildings, it was an extremely effective tool.
He also wanted them!
First aid spray.
He also needed to prepare a life-saving item...
Fang Heng roughly estimated that he needed at least 40,000 survival points to buy these items.
He had to think of a way to earn points first.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Intruders
paragraphs: "Brother Snake, look, I told you I wasn't lying, right? The prison has been occupied by players."
Outside the prison, in the shadows of the forest, Prisoner Snake was holding a pair of toy binoculars to check the situation inside the prison.
Yesterday, when Prisoner Snake heard from his subordinate that the prison had been occupied, his first reaction was disbelief.
What a joke! There were so many zombies in the prison. How could they suddenly disappear?
After repeatedly confirming the accuracy of the information, Prisoner Snake brought his elite troops to investigate the situation.
"Well done. You've done a great job."
Prisoner Snake put away his toy binoculars and revealed a cruel smile.
How the zombies disappeared was no longer important.
What was important was that he found a "fat sheep".
The group of subordinates he gathered were all players with combat talents.
These men were good fighters but they were weak in survival and constructing skills.
In the beginning, the team did develop as Prisoner Snake had planned. They robbed other players to get resources.
But after a while, Prisoner Snake discovered a problem.
They had robbed most of the players around them.
Some died, some fled.
Now, not to mention resources, Prisoner Snake and his men could not even solve the problem of food.
Without food, the team's morale drop day by day. Prisoner Snake became very anxious as a result.
Good!
This prison was an opportunity given to him by God!
Prisoner Snake thought to himself.
There would be no lack of materials in such a large prison.
As long as the players living in the prison were driven out, they could then occupy the prison.
In the future, he could even use the prison as a starting point to establish a massive force!
Unknowingly, Prisoner Snake's ambition swelled up once again.
He had long been unhappy with the small cabin he used to live in!
"Brother Snake, the prison's defence seems to be built pretty well."
"Tsk, so what if it's built pretty well? Isn't it built for us? Do I have to thank them?"
Prisoner Snake sneered in disdain and gave his subordinates a disgusted look.
"Brothers! Come with me!"
The players took out their weapons and swaggered toward the prison together with Prisoner Snake.
Prisoner Snake was the first to walk to the side of the barbed wire outside the prison.
He raised his leg and kicked forward fiercely.
"Bang!"
The barbed wire made a sound and shook heavily. Its durability dropped by 2 points.
"Hmph!
Prisoner Snake snorted coldly.
Seeing that the players in the prison didn't have any reaction, Prisoner Snake waved his hand and said, "Smash them all."
"Okay!"
Behind him, Prisoner Snake's subordinates raised their stone hammers and smashed at the barbed wire fence on the outermost layer of the prison.
"Clang! Clang! Clang!"
Under the attack of the stone hammers, the barbed wire fence shook and made loud noises.
Prisoner Snake looked at the three buildings in the prison. His eyes were filled with greed.
He was going to take over this prison!
The excited Prisoner Snake and his subordinates did not notice anything.
At this moment, in the forest behind them, two pairs of eyes were staring at them.
"The God is going to be in trouble."
Lu Yu crouched in the bushes and carefully observed Prisoner Snake and the others.
"I know the leader. His nickname is Prisoner Snake. He is a mercenary with a bad reputation. I heard that over the past few days, quite several players' residences nearby have been attacked by them."
"Chi, a bunch of scumbags." Zhou Yi did not have a good impression of these people. He asked in a low voice, "How many can you handle?"
Lu Yu had combat-type talent skills. He re-examined the enemies.
"They have too many people. We can only take down two with a sneak attack."
"Okay, let's not expose ourselves yet. Send a message to the God. Later, we can coordinate with him. We can attack from the outside while they attack from the inside."
"Okay."
Lu Yu nodded. He turned on the survival radio and sent an urgent message to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng had just returned to the prison's Building No. 3 from the apocalypse merchant camp not long ago.
He was making arrangements for the three newly recruited mercenaries in the basement warehouse.
Pistols, bullets, prison guard uniforms, explosion-proof shields...
All of them were going to be deployed!
Prison guard uniforms were collected from the prison's changing room.
After wearing the full set, it could increase the accuracy of all firearms by 2%. The explosion-proof shield did not have any attribute bonus, but it could block part of the attack.
Fang Heng did not wear it.
The main reason was that he found the uniform too ugly and bloated.
Moreover, he would not personally participate in the battle.
In addition, Level 5 mercenaries were temporarily unable to be equipped with sniper rifles.
What a pity that no one could use a sniper rifle yet.
Perhaps after completing the mission of the Dark Knights, only mercenaries with higher levels could use a sniper rifle.
Fang Heng was giving orders to the three mercenaries to patrol and guard the prison when he suddenly noticed the emergency communication on the survival radio.
He opened the survival radio.

Lu Yu: "God, there are people causing trouble outside the prison! It's Prisoner Snake's group. They've destroyed many players' residences before, and many people are coming this time. They don't come with good intentions, you all have to be careful!"
Lu Yu: "We're hiding in the forest behind them now. We are waiting for your command. Call me if you're about to make a move.
Prisoner Snake? Is it the group that was preparing to attack the small cabin earlier on?
Fang Heng had some impression.
Did they come looking for him so quickly?
He quickly replied with a message.
Fang Heng: "Roger, hide first and wait for my news."
Fang Heng turned off the survival radio and called for the three mercenaries to follow. He was prepared to go out and meet Prisoner Snake and his group of intruders.
"Boss!"
Before Fang Heng could leave, Liao Bufan pushed open the door of the warehouse basement.
"Boss, we're in trouble. Prisoner Snake and the others are here again! These b*st*rds are bullying us..."
Liao Bufan's voice became weaker as he spoke.
"F*ck!? Mercenary!?"
Liao Bufan thought he was seeing things. He rubbed his eyes.
He wasn't seeing things!
They were mercenaries!
"You... finished building the shelter?"
"Yeah, just finished. I didn't have time to tell you. It's just next door."
Fang Heng patted Liao Bufan on the shoulder and said, "Come, let's go out and see Prisoner Snake. I'll show you around later."
Liao Bufan stood there in a daze.
For a moment, the number of years flashed through his mind.
Big Brother finished building the shelter?
There seemed to be a game notification in the morning that a player had taken the lead in building a super-large shelter.
Now, the players were guessing who had completed this shelter.
It was very strange that no gaming company, gaming club or game guild had come forward to claim such an easy advertising opportunity...
In the past two days, Big Brother had also collected and manufactured a large number of wooden planks and nails...
Liao Bufan thought about it and quickly connected the three things.
Could it be...
Liao Bufan knocked his head.
It must be it!
The first person to build a super-large shelter was Fang Heng, right!
God! Big Brother was indeed powerful!
Not only did he complete the shelter, but he even got the mercenaries in just one morning!
"Wait for me!"
When he came back to his senses, Liao Bufan saw that Fang Heng had already disappeared at the entrance of the passageway, so he hurriedly chased after him.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Timely Assistance
paragraphs: Outside the prison, Prisoner Snake quickly noticed Fang Heng and the others walking out of Building No. 3.
He raised his hand, signalling his subordinates to temporarily stop attacking the barbed wire fence on the outer layer of the prison.
"Are you the leader here? Come out and speak!"
Fang Heng didn't get too close. He stood more than 30 meters away from everyone, coldly staring at the nine players standing outside the barbed wire fence.
"That's me."
Prisoner Snake was sizing up this handsome young man in front of him.
His mood turned foul.
He hated this kind of person who looked better than him the most!
"Oh? You're quite brave, aren't you?"
"Quite brave? What do you mean?"
Prisoner Snake revealed a disdainful expression. He revealed a fierce expression as he stared at Fang Heng.
"I say, you have guts. You dare to occupy our territory!"
"We finally cleared out this prison area and now you're taking over this place? What kind of logic is that?"
"Do you think we're easy to bully?"
The players behind Prisoner Snake also started to jeer.
"Yeah! Hurry up! Hand over this place, leave all the food and materials behind, and we'll let you live!"
"Hurry up and get lost!"
"Get lost! Get lost! Get lost!"
Fang Heng looked at them coldly.
He was too lazy to waste his breath. These people were here to cause trouble.
Liao Bufan couldn't take it anymore.
He had never seen such a shameless person.
He was so angry that he started cursing.
"Bullsh*t! We were here first and we were the ones who cleaned up the zombies here!"
"Hahaha! You think you can do that?"
Prisoner Snake didn't believe Liao Bufan at all.
He thought that there must have been an accident in the game that caused the zombies to leave.
These people took advantage of them.
Prisoner Snake and his companions laughed.
"Cut the crap. You're not going to get lost, are you? Then smash it! When I catch you, I won't be so easy on you!"
Seeing that the negotiation was ineffective, Prisoner Snake waved his hand to initiate the attack.
The players behind him swarmed forward and smashed the barbed wire with their small stone hammers.
The durability of the barbed wire began to slowly decrease.
If they were going to attack in this manner, it would take less than an hour to break a small hole in the barbed wire.
Prisoner Snake crossed his arms and looked at Fang Heng behind the barbed wire with great interest as if victory was within his grasp.
He really could not think of any way for Fang Heng and the others to resist, nor did he notice Fang Heng's calm expression.
Not far away, Lu Yu and Zhou Yi, who were secretly observing all this, became anxious when they saw Prisoner Snake and the others attacking the prison's barbed wire.
"The God is in trouble. Should we go up and help?"
"Of course, we have to help. The God has treated us quite well. We can't just stand by and watch."
Zhou Yi was anxious. He stared at the intruders near the barbed wire fence and thought of a countermeasure.
"Oh right, we still have the earth-made bombs from before, right? When this group of people are closer to one another, we can throw two bombs at them later. We will give them a good time!"
"Good idea!" Lu Yu agreed. "When they are in a state of confusion, I will sneak attack on two of them and you will hold on to one."
"That's right. When the time comes, we can work together with the God and the others to get rid of this group of people."
In a short while, Zhou Yi and Lu Yu had already planned out a simple and effective strategy to defeat the enemy.
The two of them had been tense all this time started to relax a little.
Lu Yu teased, "As expected of our 'Crouching Dragon'. To be able to come up with such a thorough plan in just a few seconds, it's admirable."
Zhou Yi smiled smugly, waved his hand and said humbly.
"You must be joking, 'Young Phoenix'. In this world, there are only a handful of people who can follow my train of thought. You are one of them."
Lu Yu said, "I'll contact God and have them prepare to cooperate with us from inside and outside."
"Don't rush, hold on!"
Zhou Yi hurriedly stopped Lu Yu.
"The God hasn't asked us for help yet. How can 'adding icing to the cake' be better than 'sending charcoal in the snow'?"
"Let's wait a little longer. When the God can't hold on any longer, we'll appear as his Savior and increase our favorability rating with the God."
Lu Yu's eyes lit up.
"That makes sense! Boss is a genius!"
"Hehe, you too..."
"Bang!"
A gunshot rang out.
Both Zhou Yi and Lu Yu, who were in the middle of their discussion, were shocked. They turned their heads to look in the direction of the prison square.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!!!"
Gunshots rang out in the prison square!
What's going on?!
They were shocked to find that the arrogant Prisoner Snake and his gang had actually fled in all directions in an instant.
Among this group of people, Prisoner Snake was the fastest to flee!
Crazy!
Prisoner Snake was going crazy now!
The enemy actually had a gun!
There was more than one gun!!
There were also mercenaries!
There was more than one mercenary!
Moreover, they were at least Level 3 mercenaries!
Ordinary players were at low levels and lacked gun mastery skills. The accuracy of their pistols was poor and the damage from a long-distance shot might not be fatal.
However, mercenaries were different!
Prisoner Snake could now confirm that the enemy's mercenary level was definitely not low!
At least Level 3!
From such a long distance, with just two rounds of shooting, they had already killed one player and three players were slightly injured.
All the players under Prisoner Snake made the same move when they saw their teammates fall.
Turn around.
Run!!
Prisoner Snake was now seriously regretting his actions.
If he had known that the players in this prison had such strong equipment, he would not have come to this prison even if he was beaten to death!
He had a premonition that after this attack, his subordinates would suffer heavy casualties!
What was more important was his prestige!
After this, the prestige that he had painstakingly built up in the team would drop to the bottom.
But now, he had no time to think about this!
Escaping was the most important thing!
The moment he saw Fang Heng draw his gun, he knew that he was in trouble.
He immediately turned around and ran.
He was the fastest to escape, but Fang Heng had already aimed at him.
Fang Heng's perceptive ability added an additional hit rate for him.
In addition, Fang Heng also had Level 1 gun mastery, which added an additional hit rate.
Fang Heng only fired one shot.
This bullet accurately hit the left shoulder of Prisoner Snake!
"Unfortunately, it missed a little."
Prisoner Snake ignored the intense pain in his left shoulder and ran desperately.
Prisoner Snake and his group, who had been aggressive just a moment ago, fled in all directions in a fluster. In an instant, they had all fled without a trace.
In less than two minutes, the prison and its surroundings returned to a calm and peaceful state.
In the bushes, Lu Yu retracted his gaze.
He looked at Zhou Yi beside him with a complicated expression.
He wanted to ask this question now.
"Mr Crouching Dragon, where's the 'coal in the snow'? Did you manage to foresee all this?"
Zhou Yi opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but he couldn't.
His face was full of bitterness.
Regret!
And he said he would deliver coal in the snow?
Bullsh*t! Now there wasn't even any icing on the cake!
Seeing the twisted expression on Zhou Yi's face, Lu Yu felt it was better not to provoke him.
After all, Zhou Yi's mental state had not been very good these two days.
He patted Zhou Yi's shoulder to comfort him.
"Don't take it to heart. After all, there are not many gods like Fang Heng. He is the first to complete the construction of a super-large shelter. He must have some talent."
"Recruiting mercenaries..."
Lu Yu sighed in his heart.
"Sigh! Recruiting mercenaries is something only he can do, right?"
"We're mortals after all. We can't have predicted this."
"Moreover, Fang Heng is our partner. He's our teammate. We should be happy that he's strong."
Zhou Yi listened to the persuasion and didn't feel much better. He just nodded bitterly.
This was the truth but he just couldn't be happy.
Lu Yu was helpless.
"Let's go. Cheer up. Let's go find the God to receive the mission reward."

You dare to occupy our territory!"
"We finally cleared out this prison area and now you're taking over this place?
What kind of logic is that?"
"Do you think we're easy to bully?"
The players behind Prisoner Snake also started to jeer.
"Yeah!
Hurry up!
Hand over this place, leave all the food and materials behind, and we'll let you live!"
"Hurry up and get lost!"
"Get lost!
Get lost!
Get lost!"
Fang Heng looked at them coldly.
He was too lazy to waste his breath.
These people were here to cause trouble.
Liao Bufan couldn't take it anymore.
He had never seen such a shameless person.
He was so angry that he started cursing.
"Bullsh*t!
We were here first and we were the ones who cleaned up the zombies here!"
"Hahaha!
You think you can do that?"
Prisoner Snake didn't believe Liao Bufan at all.
He thought that there must have been an accident in the game that caused the zombies to leave.
These people took advantage of them.
Prisoner Snake and his companions laughed.
"Cut the crap.
You're not going to get lost, are you?
Then smash it!
When I catch you, I won't be so easy on you!"
Seeing that the negotiation was ineffective, Prisoner Snake waved his hand to initiate the attack.
The players behind him swarmed forward and smashed the barbed wire with their small stone hammers.
The durability of the barbed wire began to slowly decrease.
If they were going to attack in this manner, it would take less than an hour to break a small hole in the barbed wire.
Prisoner Snake crossed his arms and looked at Fang Heng behind the barbed wire with great interest as if victory was within his grasp.
He really could not think of any way for Fang Heng and the others to resist, nor did he notice Fang Heng's calm expression.
Not far away, Lu Yu and Zhou Yi, who were secretly observing all this, became anxious when they saw Prisoner Snake and the others attacking the prison's barbed wire.
"The God is in trouble.
Should we go up and help?"
"Of course, we have to help.
The God has treated us quite well.
We can't just stand by and watch."
Zhou Yi was anxious.
He stared at the intruders near the barbed wire fence and thought of a countermeasure.
"Oh right, we still have the earth-made bombs from before, right?
When this group of people are closer to one another, we can throw two bombs at them later.
We will give them a good time!"
"Good idea!" Lu Yu agreed.
"When they are in a state of confusion, I will sneak attack on two of them and you will hold on to one."
"That's right.
When the time comes, we can work together with the God and the others to get rid of this group of people."
In a short while, Zhou Yi and Lu Yu had already planned out a simple and effective strategy to defeat the enemy.
The two of them had been tense all this time started to relax a little.
Lu Yu teased, "As expected of our 'Crouching Dragon'.
To be able to come up with such a thorough plan in just a few seconds, it's admirable."
Zhou Yi smiled smugly, waved his hand and said humbly.
"You must be joking, 'Young Phoenix'.
In this world, there are only a handful of people who can follow my train of thought.
You are one of them."
Lu Yu said, "I'll contact God and have them prepare to cooperate with us from inside and outside."
"Don't rush, hold on!"
Zhou Yi hurriedly stopped Lu Yu.
"The God hasn't asked us for help yet.
How can 'adding icing to the cake' be better than 'sending charcoal in the snow'?"
"Let's wait a little longer.
When the God can't hold on any longer, we'll appear as his Savior and increase our favorability rating with the God."
Lu Yu's eyes lit up.
"That makes sense!
Boss is a genius!"
"Hehe, you too..."
"Bang!"
A gunshot rang out.
Both Zhou Yi and Lu Yu, who were in the middle of their discussion, were shocked.
They turned their heads to look in the direction of the prison square.
"Bang!
Bang!
Bang!!!"
Gunshots rang out in the prison square!
What's going on?!
They were shocked to find that the arrogant Prisoner Snake and his gang had actually fled in all directions in an instant.
Among this group of people, Prisoner Snake was the fastest to flee!
Crazy!
Prisoner Snake was going crazy now!
The enemy actually had a gun!
There was more than one gun!!
There were also mercenaries!
There was more than one mercenary!
Moreover, they were at least Level 3 mercenaries!
Ordinary players were at low levels and lacked gun mastery skills.
The accuracy of their pistols was poor and the damage from a long-distance shot might not be fatal.
However, mercenaries were different!
Prisoner Snake could now confirm that the enemy's mercenary level was definitely not low!
At least Level 3!
From such a long distance, with just two rounds of shooting, they had already killed one player and three players were slightly injured.
All the players under Prisoner Snake made the same move when they saw their teammates fall.
Turn around.
Run!!
Prisoner Snake was now seriously regretting his actions.
If he had known that the players in this prison had such strong equipment, he would not have come to this prison even if he was beaten to death!
He had a premonition that after this attack, his subordinates would suffer heavy casualties!
What was more important was his prestige!
After this, the prestige that he had painstakingly built up in the team would drop to the bottom.
But now, he had no time to think about this!
Escaping was the most important thing!
The moment he saw Fang Heng draw his gun, he knew that he was in trouble.
He immediately turned around and ran.
He was the fastest to escape, but Fang Heng had already aimed at him.
Fang Heng's perceptive ability added an additional hit rate for him.
In addition, Fang Heng also had Level 1 gun mastery, which added an additional hit rate.
Fang Heng only fired one shot.
This bullet accurately hit the left shoulder of Prisoner Snake!
"Unfortunately, it missed a little."
Prisoner Snake ignored the intense pain in his left shoulder and ran desperately.
Prisoner Snake and his group, who had been aggressive just a moment ago, fled in all directions in a fluster.
In an instant, they had all fled without a trace.
In less than two minutes, the prison and its surroundings returned to a calm and peaceful state.
In the bushes, Lu Yu retracted his gaze.
He looked at Zhou Yi beside him with a complicated expression.
He wanted to ask this question now.
"Mr Crouching Dragon, where's the 'coal in the snow'?
Did you manage to foresee all this?"
Zhou Yi opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but he couldn't.
His face was full of bitterness.
Regret!
And he said he would deliver coal in the snow?
Bullsh*t!
Now there wasn't even any icing on the cake!
Seeing the twisted expression on Zhou Yi's face, Lu Yu felt it was better not to provoke him.
After all, Zhou Yi's mental state had not been very good these two days.
He patted Zhou Yi's shoulder to comfort him.
"Don't take it to heart.
After all, there are not many gods like Fang Heng.
He is the first to complete the construction of a super-large shelter.
He must have some talent."
"Recruiting mercenaries..."
Lu Yu sighed in his heart.
"Sigh!
Recruiting mercenaries is something only he can do, right?"
"We're mortals after all.
We can't have predicted this."
"Moreover, Fang Heng is our partner.
He's our teammate.
We should be happy that he's strong."
Zhou Yi listened to the persuasion and didn't feel much better.
He just nodded bitterly.
This was the truth but he just couldn't be happy.
Lu Yu was helpless.
"Let's go.
Cheer up.
Let's go find the God to receive the mission reward."

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Mining
paragraphs: Inside the prison.
Liao Bufan swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
He looked at the three mercenaries behind Fang Heng. His eyes were full of stars as he muttered to himself.
"Amazing, amazing..."
"I heard that these mercenaries are very expensive."
"Boss, what level did you buy?"
Fang Heng answered casually, "Level 5."
"Awesome! It's the best selection!"
Liao Bufan couldn't help but exclaim in admiration, his heart filled with envy.
Was this the feeling of being the Boss?!
Commanding so many underlings to hold onto their guns and watch the enemy flee...
This feeling was f*cking awesome!
Fang Heng took a look at the loss.
In less than a minute, he had used more than fifty bullets.
Mercenaries were useful, but they were a little resource-intensive.
And this was a Level 5 mercenary.
The hit rate and damage of their firearms were relatively high, so they saved more bullets. If it was a low-level mercenary, the bullet consumption would be higher.
Fang Heng wanted to chase after them and finish off Prisoner Snake and the others, but the risk was too great.
Prisoner Snake and his gang all had combat-type talent. If he forced them into a corner, the mercenaries would inevitably be injured.
He could not afford to pay the high pension.
"God!"
Lu Yu and Zhou Yi walked out of the prison's sentry cabin.
"Oh, you're back."
Fang Heng waved his hand to greet them.
Zhou Yi had a special talent skill - geographical exploration.
It was because of this that Fang Heng chose to cooperate with them not long ago.
Through geographical exploration, Zhou Yi could roughly identify whether there were mineral deposits in an area.
This talent was rated as A-level, which was a relatively rare skill.
In the early stages of the game, players did not have time to mine, so this skill was currently useless.
At least in the later stages of the game, players would only start mining after they had established a primary shelter.
The number of mineral resources in the apocalyptic world was limited and in the later stages of the game, there were often gaming companies fighting over the mining of some ores.
Fang Heng had now completed the construction of the primary shelter. If he wanted to reinforce the shelter's defence, he would need to reinforce the wooden houses with steel and cement, and so on.
All of these required a large number of mineral resources.
Two days ago, Fang Heng had asked Zhou Yi to help him search for mineral resources because he had made plans in advance for the next step of reinforcing the shelter.
But now, his plans had changed.
Right now, he urgently needed apocalyptic points to buy equipment and go on an adventure in the city.

As long as he could dig up the mineral deposits, Fang Heng could sell them to the merchants of the apocalypse camps. He could quickly exchange them for survival points through the ore collection mission issued by the apocalypse merchants.
Fang Heng noticed that Zhou Yi seemed to have a lot on his mind and did not seem very happy. He thought that they might have encountered trouble.
"What's wrong? Did you meet with some trouble?"
"Sigh!"
Zhou Yi looked at the three high-level mercenaries behind Fang Heng who were equipped with pistols and sighed.
"No."

Fang Heng was puzzled. He thought to himself, "If there's no problem, why do you give such a long sigh? You have completed the mission so quickly and even earned a huge sum of money. Why are you still not happy?"
Lu Yu said, "We found a small mineral vein, but the distance is a little far. The location is in the coordinate system (38912, 29123). God, we can set off to bring you there at any time."
"Okay, I'll get ready. We'll go later."
Fang Heng felt that he had taken another small step toward his dream of "emptying the entire apocalypse merchant camp".
On a small path close to the foot of the mountain.
A group of zombies wearing lumberyard uniforms completely occupied the path and marched forward in a mighty manner.
Lu Yu and Zhou Yi, who were surrounded by the zombies, were terrified.
Terrifying!
They were all zombies!
If they were accidentally caught, they would immediately be infected with the GG-virus.
At the same time, the two of them couldn't help but sigh in their hearts.
So that was God's talent skill!
Summoning a zombie team!
They had never heard of similar talent skills in the King of Gods' game.
This is definitely a 100% S-level talent skill!
"We'll be there soon. Over there, we'll reach the coal mine in less than 100 meters."
Zhou Yi stopped at an intersection in front of the path.
"My character is only Level 3 now. I can't find the exact location. We'll probably be able to find coal after digging along the mountain wall for a while."
"My skills are relatively low, so I can only find miniature coal mines. The reserves won't be very high."
Fang Heng looked in the direction that Zhou Yi pointed.
They were already at the edge of the mountain forest region.
It had taken them nearly three hours to walk from the prison.
It was still a bit far.
"We've checked. There are two small houses less than 200 meters away from the fork in the road. None of them is occupied by players."
"We've already cleaned up the small houses before we came here. We can rest there tonight."
Seeing that there were only one and a half hours left before it gets dark, Zhou Yi began to think about spending the night.
"If we're careful, it shouldn't be a big problem."
Zhou Yi asked for Fang Heng's opinion.
"What do you think, God?"
Fang Heng had no objection to Zhou Yi's plan.
"I don't have any objections. I'll leave the repair of the residence to you. I'll go check on the mine."
"No problem. I'll go reinforce the house and clean up the zombies in the area. That way, we won't be disturbed when we sleep at night."
At first, Zhou Yi was very careful when he left the prison. After all, being away from their residence would bring them more risks.
But now, he was completely relaxed.
After all, the God had so many zombies with him.
What problem could there be?
The three of them split up.
"Coal mine."
Fang Heng walked straight along the path, muttering to himself.
Coal was a high-value resource in the game.
From the early to middle stages of the game, players would use a lot of iron nuggets to build shelters and make tools.
Furthermore, the furnaces needed to make iron nuggets needed fuel 24 hours a day.
Ordinary wood was inefficient as fuel.
Players would use coal as fuel.
In addition, in the middle and later stages of the game, players also needed a lot of coal to make gunpowder.
Compared to other ore materials, the production of coal in the game was relatively high.
Fang Heng walked along the path to the rock wall, took out wood, stones, firewood and some basic materials from his backpack, and threw them on the ground.
Then, he sat on one side.
The zombie clones began to move.
They walked to the materials, picked up the materials and started to make stone pickaxes.
[Hint: You have completed the production of stone pickaxes. Your basic production experience points +1.]
[Hint: You have completed the production of stone pickaxes. Your basic production experience points +1.]
[Hint: You have completed the production of stone pickaxes...]
[Hint: Your basic production level has been raised to the current upper limit. Please upgrade your character's level.]
After the production was completed, the zombie clones each held a stone pickaxe and walked to the rock wall, waving the pickaxe.
Soon, the sound of mining was heard.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has destroyed a small part of the mountain. You have obtained a small stone*1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has destroyed a small part of the mountain. You have obtained a small stone*5.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has destroyed a small part of the mountain. You have obtained a small stone*2. You have learned a basic life skill-mining. Your basic mining experience points +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has gained a small stone*3, a large stone*1, your basic mining experience points +7.]
[ hint: Your zombie clone obtained large stones*1, your basic mining experience points +3.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone obtained small stones*3, large stones*1, your basic mining experience points +3.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone obtained...]
Fang Heng took out a can of coke from his backpack and opened the tab.
"Gulp gulp gulp..."
After gulping down a can of coke, Fang Heng burped comfortably.
It was comfortable to watch people work in the mines.
In Fang Heng's memory, this body used to work in similar jobs to earn money. He was so worn out after that.
"This is awkward. I should have bought some iron pickaxes when I went to the apocalypse merchant camp. Now the mining efficiency is a little slow..."
Fang Heng glanced at the setting sun.
"It's too late to rush back now. I can only wait for tomorrow."

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - Mood
paragraphs: [Hint: Your zombie clone has obtained coal*21, your basic mining experience points +29.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has obtained coal*16, your basic mining experience points +21.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has obtained coal*22...]
[Hint: Your mining skill level has been upgraded to Level 2.]
Half an hour later, seeing that the zombies had found coal, Fang Heng patted the dust off his pants and stood up from the ground.
It was time to go back and see what the accommodation for tonight was going to be like.
The night was approaching.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu divided the work and cleaned up some of the zombies around the hut. Then, they reinforced the wooden doors and windows of the hut to ensure its safety at night.
Everyone lit a bonfire in the hut.
“You two have worked hard these past few days!”
Fang Heng casually took out a handful of cold beer from his backpack and placed it beside the bonfire. Then, he threw two cans of beer to the two of them.
“Sorry for displaying my immature skill but tonight, I’ll be cooking for all. Come and have a taste of my cooking.”
It was a big skewer of meat!
This was Fang Heng’s ultimate skill.
In the game, with the addition of the recipe skill, the taste of the big skewer of meat was so good that it was out of the world!
One could never get tired of it!
For this reason, Fang Heng even carried a barbecue grill with him. He could eat whenever he wanted to.
He took out the meat pieces and made them into skewers. He placed them on the grill and kept turning them, just like a chef.
The oil from the fatty acids of the meat sizzled under the heat.
The aroma of the skewers drifted directly into Lu Yu and Zhou Yi’s nostrils.
They couldn’t help but drool!
In the zombie apocalypse game, Lu Yu and Zhou Yi were considered professional players.
They had been studying the game’s strategy, so they knew a lot about the game.
However, despite their rich experience, all they had been eating these days were baked potatoes, wild vegetables, roasted berries and roasted bird eggs...
They had to live a miserable life, barely having enough to eat.

After all, they had been desperately completing the apocalypse merchant’s mission during the day and earning survival points to exchange for earth-made bombs. They didn’t have the extra time to go and find food.
They had never thought that there would be someone in the game who could actually be eating big skewers of meat and drinking wine so happily!
When they saw Fang Heng sprinkled cumin on the skewered meat and carefully coated it with a layer of secret sauce, both of their eyes were wide open.
What the heck!
They were wondering if he was here to survive the game or to participate in a gourmet competition?
This kind of behaviour was too much!
Fang Heng raised the beer can.
“It’s been hard on the two of you. Cheers! Let’s continue to collaborate in the future!”
“Happy cooperation! If you need our help in the future, feel free to look for us. We are very reliable!”
Zhou Yi held up the big meat skewer and took a bite.
It was delicious!
The gravy was packed with freshness, and the fats from the meat were bursting in his mouth!
The seasoning blended perfectly!
The slightly bursting taste enhanced the aroma of the meat and flowed down from the nose to the throat.
Delicacies could heal the soul and chase away fatigue.
Zhou Yi ate skewers of meat and drank beer.

His mood for the past few days had been on the low side as he was constantly affected by Fang Heng’s actions. But he seemed to have finally recovered a little bit and currently, he could enjoy the hard-won happiness during the apocalypse.
He had his fill.
Lu Yu and Zhou Yi strongly requested to be responsible for tonight’s vigil as an affirmation of the meal.
Fang Heng did not object.
The few of them began to chat casually again.
“Oh right, God, although we have defeated Prisoner Snake and the others today, we still have to be careful.”
“Oh?” Fang Heng was surprised. He put down the beer in his hand. “They still dare to come?”
“God, don’t forget that in a few days, the game will open up a channel transmission service.”
Zhou Yi explained to Fang Heng with a straight face.
“When the time comes, all players below level 5 in the King of Gods’ game can spend their points to enter our game world.”
“Prisoner Snake is famous for his bad character, but many people don’t want to provoke him.”
“He used to join a gaming guild called ‘Dawn’. This time, they failed to attack the prison. They probably guessed that it was you who established the super-large shelter.”
“If he reports to the guild about what happened in the prison, I’m afraid you’ll be in trouble.”
“Dawn...”
Fang Heng muttered softly and nodded.
This body had the memories of the guild.
Dawn had a very bad reputation in the game. Most of the players in the guild were a bunch of villains.
It was indeed true.
After the prison and the mercenaries were exposed, Fang Heng felt that he had to face those greedy villains.
And as time passed, the restrictions of the game would gradually be opened up.
Two days later, the ban on players below Level 5 would be lifted.
After a month, players below Level 10 would also be able to use their King of Gods’ points to enter the game.
Fang Heng had a premonition that trouble was gradually approaching.
But he was not afraid of trouble.
In the beginning, he hid his identity carefully and developed silently. He had made this decision so that he can buy more time for the prison to develop and avoid unwanted attention.
But it would also greatly sacrifice his development speed.
Fang Heng felt that if the enemy was coming, then let them come!
What he wanted to do was to always be one step ahead of the players and act on his initiative!
He would use his strength to crush them and he was not afraid of it!
If they came, he would kill them, one after another!
Although Fang Heng was afraid of death, he still preferred to face them head-on!
The next day.
The sun rose, dispelling the darkness.
Zhou Yi, who was on the vigil, stretched himself.
He was lucky.
It was very quiet last night. No zombies came to disturb him.
Furthermore, he had eaten and drunk enough last night. His mood was much better than the last few days.
He stood up and prepared to go outside to breathe some fresh air.
“Come on, Zhou Yi! Don’t be decadent! Face life positively!”
Zhou Yi patted his cheeks to encourage himself.
He also realized that he had been suffering from ‘blows’ by Fang Heng during this period and his morale was somewhat low.
“Clack...”
Pushing open the wooden door of the hut, Zhou Yi was greatly surprised.
What was this?
Outside the hut, the stones that were gathered earlier on had piled up into more than ten two-meter-high ‘small hills’.
These small hills were also mixed with small black stones.
Black stones...
Hmm?
Was it coal ore?
Zhou Yi was puzzled.
What was going on?
He wondered if he was hallucinating because he had only slept for four hours last night.
Zhou Yi slowly walked to the front of a small hill and picked up a small piece of black coal.
The coal immediately disappeared from his hand.
[Hint: You have obtained coal*1.]
It was real!
It wasn’t an illusion, it was just coal!
Bloody hell!
Where did all these coal mines come from?
Out of thin air?
Were ghosts behind this? Was there a bug in the system?
Zhou Yi was puzzled and he looked around.
He saw a zombie staggering over from afar.
Zhou Yi reflexively raised his weapon.
This zombie was wearing the lumberjack uniform.
It was probably summoned by God.
Zhou Yi put down his weapon and slowly took a few steps back, still maintaining his vigilance.
The lumberjack zombie ignored Zhou Yi and had no desire to attack.
It walked past Zhou Yi and came before the newest small hill.
Then, Zhou Yi saw a scene that he would never forget for the rest of his life.
The lumberjack zombie took out pieces of rocks from its backpack and threw them at the small hill, adding bricks and tiles to the small hill that was erected high up.
After doing all this, it turned around and went back the way it came from.
Behind it, two more zombies walked back one after another, repeating the same action.
“This...”
“No way...”
“Could it be that these zombies can mine?”
Zhou Yi felt like he was going crazy.
“Impossible! How can zombies help players mine?”
“This is illogical!”
He immediately followed the zombies, wanting to see what had happened with his own eyes.
Five minutes later, Zhou Yi arrived at the mountain wall.
After one night, a ten-meter-deep hole had been dug in the mountain wall
The group of zombies he saw yesterday were waving their stone pickaxes and pounding the mountain wall with all their might.
Zhou Yi silently sat down.
He didn’t know what was going on...
His mood suddenly became bad again.

The night was approaching.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu divided the work and cleaned up some of the zombies around the hut.
Then, they reinforced the wooden doors and windows of the hut to ensure its safety at night.
Everyone lit a bonfire in the hut.
“You two have worked hard these past few days!”
Fang Heng casually took out a handful of cold beer from his backpack and placed it beside the bonfire.
Then, he threw two cans of beer to the two of them.
“Sorry for displaying my immature skill but tonight, I’ll be cooking for all.
Come and have a taste of my cooking.”
It was a big skewer of meat!
This was Fang Heng’s ultimate skill.
In the game, with the addition of the recipe skill, the taste of the big skewer of meat was so good that it was out of the world!
One could never get tired of it!
For this reason, Fang Heng even carried a barbecue grill with him.
He could eat whenever he wanted to.
He took out the meat pieces and made them into skewers.
He placed them on the grill and kept turning them, just like a chef.
The oil from the fatty acids of the meat sizzled under the heat.
The aroma of the skewers drifted directly into Lu Yu and Zhou Yi’s nostrils.
They couldn’t help but drool!
In the zombie apocalypse game, Lu Yu and Zhou Yi were considered professional players.
They had been studying the game’s strategy, so they knew a lot about the game.
However, despite their rich experience, all they had been eating these days were baked potatoes, wild vegetables, roasted berries and roasted bird eggs...

When they saw Fang Heng sprinkled cumin on the skewered meat and carefully coated it with a layer of secret sauce, both of their eyes were wide open.
What the heck!
They were wondering if he was here to survive the game or to participate in a gourmet competition?
This kind of behaviour was too much!
Fang Heng raised the beer can.
“It’s been hard on the two of you.
Cheers!
Let’s continue to collaborate in the future!”

The seasoning blended perfectly!
